skills.name: Tambua na tumia vihusishi
skills.mastery: Picks the relating word (juu ya, chini ya, ndani ya, nje ya, karibu na, mbali na, kwa, kuliko) in a sentence, and chooses the -a of agreement (cha, vya, wa, ya, la) that matches the noun, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Picks a noun, a verb or an adjective as the relating word.

example.question: Ni kihusishi kipi katika sentensi: "Kitabu kiko juu ya meza."

misconceptions.cause: The child picks the word that is easiest to see.
misconceptions.reveals: A sentence with a place word, with the nouns as options.
misconceptions.help: Which words tell where the book is in relation to the table?
misconceptions.feedback: Kihusishi hueleza uhusiano wa nomino na neno lingine, kama "juu ya", "chini ya" na "ndani ya". "Meza" ni nomino.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the wrong -a of agreement for the noun (kitabu wa mwalimu, nyumba cha bibi).

example.question: Kitabu ___ mwalimu kiko mezani.

misconceptions.cause: The child keeps one form for every noun.
misconceptions.reveals: Nouns of different classes before the same word.
misconceptions.help: Which class is the noun in? Kitabu is KI-VI, so cha.
misconceptions.feedback: Kihusishi cha "a" hubadilika kulingana na ngeli: kitabu cha, vitabu vya, mlango wa, milango ya, jina la, majina ya, nyumba ya.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Swaps place words that mean the opposite (juu ya for chini ya, ndani ya for nje ya).

example.question: Samaki wanaishi ___ ya maji, si nje yake.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the words but not which way each points.
misconceptions.reveals: A sentence that says where, with the opposite word among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the clue in the sentence: inside or outside?
misconceptions.feedback: "Ndani ya" na "nje ya" ni vinyume. "Juu ya" na "chini ya" ni vinyume pia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses na where the tool is meant (aliandika na kalamu) or kwa where the companion is meant (alienda kwa mama).

example.question: Jaza: Aliandika barua ___ kalamu.

misconceptions.cause: English "with" covers both the tool and the companion.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Aliandika barua ___ kalamu." with "na" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: is it a tool (kwa) or a person going along (na)?
misconceptions.feedback: Chombo cha kufanyia kazi huchukua kwa: kwa kalamu. Mtu aliyeandamana huchukua na: na mama.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya vihisishi na kuvitolea mifano (k.m Lo!, Ala!, Salalee!, Mama ee!, Oyee! na Aha!) akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutambua vihisishi katika kundi la maneno,
kutambua alama ya hisi (!) inayoambatanishwa na vihisishi,
kutumia vihisishi kujaza nafasi katika sentensi,
kutumia vihisishi kutunga sentensi kwenye daftari akizingatia suala lengwa na masuala mtambuko mbalimbali,
kutumia vihisishi kutunga kifungu kifupi daftarini au mtandaoni ili wenzake wakisome na kukitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Kutumia vihisishi katika mawasiliano kuna umuhimu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala, kazi za vikundi na mawasiliano mtandaoni.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi unapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutambua vihisishi na kutunga sentensi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia vihisishi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua vihisishi na kuvitungia sentensi sahihi.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapochagua vihisishi kwenye kundi la maneno katika tarakilishi na kuvitia kapuni.
Umoja:mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya vihisishi na kuvitolea mifano.
sub_strands.pcis:
Umoja wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapofanya shughuli ya kikundi pamoja na wenzake wa jamii tofauti.
Uwazaji wa kina: mwanafunzi anapotumia vihisishi kutunga sentensi mtandaoni ili wenzake wazitathmini.

skills.name: Tambua na tumia vihisishi
skills.mastery: Picks the exclamation that fits the feeling in the situation (pole, hongera, samahani, karibu, lo) and picks the exclamation from a sentence, with the exclamation mark, without choosing a noun or a verb, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Words of courtesy and feeling are met together in speech.
Knowing the marks at the end of a sentence comes before the alama ya hisi.

misconceptions.error: Picks an exclamation of another feeling (hongera for pole).

example.question: Mwenzako ameanguka na kuumia. Utasema ___!

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the words but does not ask what the feeling is.
misconceptions.reveals: A sad situation, with a happy word among the options.
misconceptions.help: What does the other person feel? What would you say?
misconceptions.feedback: Kihisishi huonyesha hisia: "Pole!" kwa huzuni, "Hongera!" kwa mafanikio, "Samahani!" ukikosea, "Karibu!" kwa mgeni.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a noun or a verb for an exclamation.

example.question: Hongera! Juma ameshinda mbio za shule. Ni kihisishi kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the exclamation has the mark ! and shows a feeling.
misconceptions.reveals: A sentence that begins with an exclamation, with the other words as options.
misconceptions.help: Which word shows a feeling and carries the mark !?
misconceptions.feedback: Kihisishi kinaonyesha hisia na huandikwa pamoja na alama ya hisi (!). "Juma" ni nomino.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes an exclamation with a kikomo or no mark, not the alama ya hisi (!).

example.question: Ni ipi imeandikwa ipasavyo?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the word but not that its feeling is shown with a mark.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi imeandikwa ipasavyo?" with "Lo. Umependeza." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the line with and without feeling; the ! asks for the feeling.
misconceptions.feedback: Kihisishi hufuatwa na alama ya hisi: Lo!
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses an English exclamation (Wow!, Sorry!, Eish!) in a Kiswahili sentence.

example.question: Ni kihisishi kipi cha Kiswahili kinaonyesha mshangao?

misconceptions.cause: The child hears English and Sheng exclamations every day.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kihisishi kipi cha Kiswahili kinaonyesha mshangao?" with "Wow!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a feelings chart in Kiswahili: mshangao (Lo! Ala!), huzuni (Pole! Ole!), furaha (Hongera!).
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa Kiswahili tunasema Lo! au Ala! kwa mshangao.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua na kueleza maana ya maneno ya upole (k.m kwenda msalani, kwenda haja kubwa, kwenda haja ndogo, kuendesha na kujifungua) katika chati, mti maneno, kapu maneno, ubao, vyombo vya kidijitali,
kushiriki katika kujadili maneno ya upole akiwa na wenzake,
kutazama maigizo kuhusu matumizi ya maneno ya upole katika video na mitandaoni,
kushiriki katika maigizo yanayohusu matumizi ya maneno ya upole,
kutumia maneno ya upole katika sentensi.
key_inquiry_questions: Kutumia maneno ya upole kuna umuhimu gani katika mawasiliano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na kuigiza katika kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vyombo vya kidijitali katika ujifunzaji.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutambua maneno ya upole na kuyatumia katika kutunga sentensi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapotambua nakutumia maneno ya upole katika chati maneno.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi kwa amani.
sub_strands.pcis: Umoja wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na kushirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za vikundi kwa upole na amani.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha lugha ya upole katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English na Religious Education.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la dira na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua maneno ya upole yanayotumiwa katika mawasiliano
kutumia maneno ya upole katika mawasiliano
kuthamini matumizi ya maneno ya upole katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na tumia maneno ya upole
skills.mastery: Picks the polite word or sentence (tafadhali, samahani, asante, pole, naomba) for the situation, and does not choose a command, in 8 of 10 new items. Using them aloud is a teacher's check.

prerequisites.reason: Words of respect and courtesy of Grade 3 are the start of polite speech.
Greeting properly comes before a polite request.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Asks with a command and no polite word (Nipe maji!).

example.question: Chagua sentensi yenye upole.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not hear the tone of the order.
misconceptions.reveals: A request and a command side by side.
misconceptions.help: Which one would you like to be asked?
misconceptions.feedback: Tunapoomba kitu tunatumia "tafadhali" na "naomba", si amri.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Swaps the polite words (asante for samahani).

example.question: Umemgonga mwenzako kwa bahati mbaya. Utasema "___."

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the words but not what each is for.
misconceptions.reveals: A situation with a thank-you, an apology and a request among the options.
misconceptions.help: What did you do, and what would you want to say?
misconceptions.feedback: "Samahani" husemwa ukikosea. "Asante" husemwa ukipewa kitu. "Pole" husemwa kwa aliyeumia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a plain sentence for a polite one.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ina neno la upole?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not look for the polite word.
misconceptions.reveals: Sentences with and without a polite word.
misconceptions.help: Which sentence has a word like tafadhali, samahani or asante?
misconceptions.feedback: Maneno ya upole ni kama tafadhali, samahani, asante, pole na naomba.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the polite word in, but keeps a command form that sounds rude (Lete maji tafadhali sasa hivi!).

example.question: Ni ombi lipi lina upole zaidi?

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks adding tafadhali is enough, whatever the rest of the sentence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ombi lipi lina upole zaidi?" with "Lete maji sasa hivi, tafadhali!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Compare tone: a command with tafadhali and a request with naomba; listen to both.
misconceptions.feedback: Upole ni maneno yote: Tafadhali, naomba unipe maji.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama (k.m. kutowasiliana na watu asiowajua, kuwajibika anaposakura tovuti mbalimbali) kutoka kwenye chati au kwenye tarakilishi na mitandao,
kutambua jina la faili lengwa kwenye tarakilishi na kufanya mazoezi ya kufungua na kufunga,
kutambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake,
kutambua umuhimu wa kutoa habari kwa mwalimu, mzazi au mlezi wake endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni na kutowasiliana nao,
kutafuta maana za maneno kuhusu suala lengwa kwenye kamusi au mtandaoni,
asikilize matamshi na maelezo kuhusu anachokisoma mtandaoni panapowezekana,
kutoa habari kuhusu matini aliyosoma kwa muhtasari na kujibu maswali katika maandishi au mazungumzo na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni hatua zipi za kiusalama unazofaa kuzingatia unapotumia mtandao?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali katika kutafuta, kusakura na kusoma.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafuta matini ya kusoma kwenye tarakilishi na mitandaoni.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali na kuzingatia mitandao salama.
Uadilifu: mwanafunzi anapotoa habari kwa mwalimu au mlezi apatapo ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandoni.
sub_strands.pcis: Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotambua mitandao salama yenye matini inayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa mapana katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la dira na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua na kufungua faili iliyo na kifungu cha kusoma
kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali
kusakura matini kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma vyenye suala lengwa
kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali kwa urahisi kupata matini yanayolengwa
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutafuta na kusoma ujumbe ili kuimarisha maarifa yake

skills.name: Zingatia hatua za kiusalama unapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali
skills.mastery: Picks the safe step for a phone, tablet or computer (keep the password secret, show an adult an unknown link, give no home address to a stranger, log out, use a safe site) and not the risky one, in 8 of 10 new situations.

prerequisites.reason: The child must know the parts of the device before using it safely.
Following instructions given in class is how safety rules are learnt.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

skills.name: Fungua faili, sakura kwenye tovuti salama na usome matini ya kidijitali
skills.mastery: Opens a saved file with the passage (finds the folder, double-clicks the file), searches a safe site with two or three key words, ignores pop-ups and adverts, and reads the passage for its message, in 8 of 10 new items or tasks.

prerequisites.reason: Staying safe online comes before searching for passages.
The child must know the keyboard, mouse and screen to open a file.

misconceptions.error: Gives out a password or a private detail.

example.question: Rafiki anakuomba nenosiri la simu yako. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks that sharing with a friend is harmless.
misconceptions.reveals: A friend or a stranger who asks.
misconceptions.help: Who should know the password?
misconceptions.feedback: Nenosiri na maelezo kama anwani ni siri yako. Usimpe mtu mwingine, hata rafiki.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Opens an unknown link or file.

example.question: Umetumiwa kiungo usichokijua. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child is curious.
misconceptions.reveals: A message with a link from a stranger.
misconceptions.help: Can you tell where the link leads?
misconceptions.feedback: Kiungo au faili usiyoijua inaweza kuwa hatari. Mwonyeshe mtu mzima kabla ya kuifungua.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses any site, or one that asks for private details.

example.question: Unatafuta kifungu cha kusoma mtandaoni. Utumie tovuti ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child takes the first result.
misconceptions.reveals: A site that asks for a phone number or money.
misconceptions.help: Who said the site is safe?
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia tovuti salama zilizopendekezwa na mwalimu au mzazi. Tovuti inayoomba nambari ya simu au pesa si salama.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes up a folder and a file: looks for the passage on the screen without opening the folder it is in.

example.question: Kifungu "Dira na mwelekeo" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?
example.wrong_answer: bonyeza "Dira na mwelekeo" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo
example.correct_answer: fungua folda "Kiswahili", kisha bonyeza mara mbili faili "Dira na mwelekeo"

misconceptions.cause: The child has only used apps on a phone, where there are no folders.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kifungu "Dira na mwelekeo" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?" with "bonyeza "Dira na mwelekeo" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show a real folder (a box file) holding papers; then the same on the screen.
misconceptions.feedback: Faili huhifadhiwa ndani ya folda; fungua folda kwanza, kisha faili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Types a whole long question, with spelling mistakes, into the search box.

example.question: Unatafuta habari kuhusu dira. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?
example.wrong_answer: naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu dira tafadhali

misconceptions.cause: The child talks to the search box as to a person.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unatafuta habari kuhusu dira. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?" with "naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu dira tafadhali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the two or three words that carry the meaning; search with those; compare the results.
misconceptions.feedback: Andika maneno mawili au matatu muhimu tu, na uyaandike kwa tahajia sahihi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Clicks a pop-up or an advert that says he has won a prize.

example.question: Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usibonyeze; funga ujumbe na umwambie mwalimu au mzazi

misconceptions.cause: Offers of prizes are exciting and the child does not know they are traps.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?" with "bonyeza ili kupokea simu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show two screenshots, one real page and one trap; the child finds three signs of the trap.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe wa zawadi usiotarajiwa ni mtego; usiubonyeze.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses any site that comes up and gives his name, school or phone number when a site asks.

example.question: Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usijaze; tumia tovuti salama aliyokupa mwalimu

misconceptions.cause: The child wants the story and does not see personal details as worth protecting.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?" with "jaza ili usome hadithi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: List the details that are private; practise saying no to a form.
misconceptions.feedback: Usimpe mtu yeyote mtandaoni jina lako kamili, shule yako wala nambari ya simu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the steps of finding and reading a passage in the wrong order (reads before searching, or searches before switching on).

example.question: Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?

misconceptions.cause: The child has watched an adult do the steps quickly and remembers the parts, not the order.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?" with "andika maneno ya kutafutia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Step cards: the child orders them, then does them on a real device.
misconceptions.feedback: Washa kifaa, fungua kivinjari, andika maneno muhimu, chagua tovuti salama, soma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Chats with or agrees to meet someone met online.

example.question: Mtu usiyemjua anakuandikia mtandaoni: "Tukutane kesho dukani." Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a friendly message comes from a friend.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mtu usiyemjua anakuandikia mtandaoni: "Tukutane kesho dukani." Ufanye nini?" with "kubali na uende" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Talk through a safe adult to tell; practise blocking and reporting on a demo screen.
misconceptions.feedback: Usikutane na mtu uliyemjua mtandaoni; mwambie mzazi au mwalimu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua barua ya kirafiki kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya barua za kirafiki zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu umuhimu wa barua za kirafiki katika mawasiliano,
kujadili na wenzake mada ya barua ya kirafiki na vipengele vyake/ yale yanayofaa kujumuishwa,
kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,
kuandika barua ya kirafiki kwa rafiki, ndugu, mzazi, n.k kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,
kuwasomea wenzake na mwalimu barua yake ili waitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unazingatia nini ili kuandika barua nzuri ya kirafiki?
Barua za kirafiki inashughulikia masuala gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi za vikundi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika barua ya kirafiki.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kuandika barua ya kirafiki kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapoitathmini kazi ya wenzake.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapojadili umuhimu wa kuandika barua za kirafiki.
sub_strands.pcis: Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake wa jamii tofautitofauti kujadili umuhimu wa barua za kirafiki katika mawasiliano.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika barua ya kirafiki katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la dira na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua barua ya kirafiki kwa kuzingatia muundo wake
kujadili umuhimu wa barua ya kirafiki katika mawasiliano
kuandika barua ya kirafiki inayozingatia mada kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
kuchangamkia utunzi wa barua ya kirafiki katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua sehemu za barua ya kirafiki
skills.mastery: Names the parts of a friendly letter in their order (anwani ya mwandishi, tarehe, salamu, mwili, hitimisho, jina) and what each holds, in 8 of 10 new items. Writing the letter is composition marking.

prerequisites.reason: The margin and spaces of Grade 3 set out the parts of a letter on the page.
A letter needs capital letters, commas and full stops.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

skills.name: Andika barua ya kirafiki kwa muundo na lugha ifaayo
skills.mastery: Tells barua ya kirafiki from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a friendly letter with the address, date, greeting, asking after the friend, the news, and a friendly closing; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Knowing the parts of a friendly letter comes before writing one.
A letter needs capital letters, commas and full stops.

misconceptions.error: Puts the parts of a letter in the wrong order.

example.question: Barua ya kirafiki huanza kwa anwani ya mwandishi, kisha tarehe, kisha ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the parts but not their order.
misconceptions.reveals: The parts of a letter asked in turn.
misconceptions.help: What comes after the date, and what before the end?
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki ina anwani ya mwandishi, tarehe, salamu, mwili, hitimisho na jina.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the wrong greeting or closing for a friend (Wako mtiifu for Rafiki yako).

example.question: Hitimisho la barua ya kirafiki ni "___ ".

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes a friendly letter with an official one.
misconceptions.reveals: A friendly closing and an official one.
misconceptions.help: Who is the letter to: a friend or an officer?
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki huanza kwa "Mpendwa..." na kuisha kwa "Rafiki yako". "Wako mtiifu" ni ya barua rasmi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the address of the writer in the wrong place.

example.question: Anwani ya mwandishi huandikwa upande wa ___ juu.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes it where the greeting goes.
misconceptions.reveals: Left and right as options.
misconceptions.help: Which corner is the address of the writer?
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani ya mwandishi huandikwa upande wa kulia juu, kisha tarehe chini yake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes to a friend in the stiff words of an official letter (Mheshimiwa, Kuhusu:, Wako mtiifu).

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?

misconceptions.cause: The child has seen official letters at school and thinks every letter is written that way.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?" with "Mheshimiwa Bwana," among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put a friendly and an official letter side by side; the child highlights the words that differ.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki hutumia lugha ya kirafiki: Mpendwa rafiki, Wako akupendaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Starts with the news straight after the greeting, with no asking after the friend (maulizo ya hali).

example.question: Baada ya salamu, ni sentensi ipi inafuata katika barua ya kirafiki?
example.correct_answer: Hujambo? Natumai u buheri wa afya.

misconceptions.cause: The child goes to what he wants to say, as in a text message.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Baada ya salamu, ni sentensi ipi inafuata katika barua ya kirafiki?" with "Nataka kukueleza kuhusu safari yetu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Order the parts on cards: anwani, tarehe, salamu, maulizo ya hali, ujumbe, hitimisho, jina.
misconceptions.feedback: Baada ya salamu, uliza hali ya rafiki yako kabla ya kueleza ujumbe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the date or writes it in the middle of the letter.

example.question: Tarehe huandikwa wapi katika barua ya kirafiki?
example.correct_answer: chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, upande wa kulia juu

misconceptions.cause: The date is not part of what the child wants to say, so he forgets it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tarehe huandikwa wapi katika barua ya kirafiki?" with "mwishoni, baada ya jina" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Label a model letter; the child places a date card on a blank layout.
misconceptions.feedback: Tarehe huandikwa chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, juu upande wa kulia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends with "Wako mtiifu" and a full name and title, as in an official letter.

example.question: Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?

misconceptions.cause: Again the official model is the only one the child has copied.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?" with "Wako mtiifu, Bw. Juma Hamisi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Collect three friendly closings and keep them in the exercise book.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki humalizika kwa "Ni mimi rafiki yako," na jina la kwanza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Stops after the news, with no closing line and no name.

example.question: Barua ya kirafiki inamalizika vipi?
example.correct_answer: kwa hitimisho kama "Ni mimi rafiki yako," na jina

misconceptions.cause: The child stops when there is no more to tell, as in talking.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Barua ya kirafiki inamalizika vipi?" with "kwa habari ya mwisho tu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show where the closing goes on a model letter.
misconceptions.feedback: Malizia barua kwa hitimisho na jina lako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya ngeli za nomino akiwa na wenzake,
kutaja mifano ya nomino akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya A - WA katika umoja na wingi,
kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya A-WA kwenye sentensi alizosoma,
kushiriki katika mchezo wa kuchopoa kadi za sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya A-WA kutoka kwenye kikapu au boksi na kisha kuzisoma,
kutambua nomino za ngeli ya A-WA katika umoja na wingi katika matini,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia viambishi vya umoja na wingi wa nomino katika ngeli ya A-WA,
kuunda sentensi sahihi daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akitumia nomino za ngeli ya A-WA katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi,
kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake na mwalimu sentensi alizozitunga ili kuzitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni nini kinakuwezesha kutambua nomino za ngeli ya A-WA?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuandika nomino za ngeli ya A-WA katika umoja na wingi. Pia anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika mchezo wa kuchopoa kadi za sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya A-WA kutoka kikapuni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya A-WA katika umoja na wingi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua nomino.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza kifaa cha kidijitali anachotumia.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini mchango wa wenzake katika kuandika maneno ya ngeli ya A-WA.
Amani: mwanafunzi anapowasiliana na wenzake kutoka sehemu mbalimbali kwa kuonyesha upendo akitumia nomino za ngeli ya A-WA.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapofanya shughuli ya kuandika umoja na wingi wa nomino pamoja na wenzake.
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kusoma sentensi zilizotungwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya A-WA kwa kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ngeli za nomino katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la dira na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya A-WA
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya A-WA ili kuzitofautisha na nomino katika ngeli nyingine
kutunga sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya A-WA katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya A-WA katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya A-WA kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Knows that people and animals are in A-WA, gives a- for one and wa- for many (mtoto anacheza, watoto wanacheza), and makes the plural noun (mwalimu-walimu), in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses wa- for one person or a- for many people.

example.question: Watoto wawili ___naimba.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not count, or goes by the word before.
misconceptions.reveals: One and many in turn.
misconceptions.help: Count: one or many?
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za ngeli ya A-WA hutumia a- kwa umoja na wa- kwa wingi: mtoto anaimba, watoto wanaimba.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives animals the prefix of things (ndege inaruka) instead of A-WA (ndege wanaruka).

example.question: Ndege watatu ___naruka juu.

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks only people are in A-WA.
misconceptions.reveals: Animals, birds and insects.
misconceptions.help: Is it alive and moving? People and animals take a- and wa-.
misconceptions.feedback: Watu na wanyama wote wako katika ngeli ya A-WA: paka anaruka, ndege wanaruka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts a thing into A-WA (kitabu anasomwa).

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya A-WA?

misconceptions.cause: The child picks a noun that begins with m- or a vowel and does not ask if it is a person or an animal.
misconceptions.reveals: A person among things.
misconceptions.help: Is it a person or an animal?
misconceptions.feedback: Ngeli ya A-WA ni ya watu na wanyama. Kitabu ni kitu, kiko katika ngeli ya KI-VI.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Makes a wrong plural noun for a person (vitoto, mitoto for watoto).

example.question: Mtoto mmoja, ___ wawili.

misconceptions.cause: The child puts on a prefix from another class.
misconceptions.reveals: Singular and plural nouns of people.
misconceptions.help: Which prefix do people take for many?
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi wa mtoto ni watoto, wa mwalimu ni walimu: m- hubadilika kuwa wa-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua methali kuhusu malezi (k.v mtoto umleavyo ndivyo akuavyo, mtoto wa nyoka ni nyoka na mtoto hutazama kisogo cha nina) kutoka kwa orodha ya methali, chati au mtandaoni,
kueleza maana za methali kuhusu malezi akiwa na wenzake,
kukamilisha methali kuhusu ushauri nasaha,
kutumia methali kuhusu ushauri nasaha katika kifungu kifupi na masimulizi akiwa na wenzake
kushirikiana na mzazi au mlezi wake kutambua methali kuhusu malezi katika jamii yao.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni methali gani zinazohusu malezi?
Methali hutumiwa kufanya nini?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapohusishwa katika kazi ya vikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia mtandao kutambua methali.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotumia methali kujieleza.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutaja na kueleza maana za methali na kuthamini mchango wao.
Uwajibikaji: anapowasiliana na mzazi au mlezi akitumia methali zinazohusu malezi katika miktadha mbalimbali.
Uzalendo: mwanafunzi anapotambua methali kuhusu malezi katika jamii yake na za wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Ushauri nasaha: mwanafunzi anaposoma methali zinazohusu malezi mema.
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake wa sehemu mbalimbali kueleza maana za methali kuhusu malezi kwa amani.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya methali katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ushauri nasaha na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Religious Education.

outcomes.text: kutambua methali zinazohusu malezi katika matini tofautitofauti
kueleza maana za methali kuhusu malezi
kutumia methali zinazohusu malezi katika mawasiliano
kuchangamkia matumizi ya methali katika miktadha mbalimbali

skills.name: Tambua na eleza maana ya methali za malezi
skills.mastery: Tells a methali about upbringing from other sayings, gives what it means, and completes it, without taking it word for word or giving the meaning of another methali, in 8 of 10 new items. Using it aloud is a teacher's check.

prerequisites.reason: Knowing the words of a methali comes before its hidden meaning.
Following what a conversation is about lets the child see where a methali fits.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Takes the methali word for word.

example.question: Methali "Samaki mkunje angali mbichi" ina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads the words and not the meaning.
misconceptions.reveals: A literal meaning as an option.
misconceptions.help: What lesson is the saying giving us?
misconceptions.feedback: Methali hutumia maneno ya picha ili kutoa funzo. Maana yake ni funzo, si maneno yenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the meaning of another methali.

example.question: Methali "Mtoto umleavyo ndivyo akuavyo" ina maana gani?
example.correct_answer: Tabia ya mtoto hutokana na malezi yake

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the topic but mixes the sayings.
misconceptions.reveals: Meanings of two methali on the same topic.
misconceptions.help: Which part of the saying does the meaning explain?
misconceptions.feedback: Kila methali ina funzo lake. Soma maneno yake kwa makini kabla ya kuchagua maana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes an ordinary sentence or another saying for a methali.

example.question: Ni methali ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not tell a methali from a plain sentence.
misconceptions.reveals: A methali among plain sentences.
misconceptions.help: Does it give a lesson in few words?
misconceptions.feedback: Methali ni maneno machache yanayotoa funzo la maisha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Changes a word of the methali, or joins the beginning of one to the end of another.

example.question: Samaki mkunje ___ mbichi.

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the sense but not the exact words.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap in a methali with plausible words.
misconceptions.help: Say the methali from the beginning.
misconceptions.feedback: Methali husemwa kwa maneno yale yale: "Samaki mkunje angali mbichi". Tukibadilisha neno, haitambuliki.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua shairi, beti na mishororo katika matini mbalimbali kama vile vitabu, chati na vilevile kwa kutumia tarakilishi,
kushiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu maana za shairi, ubeti na mishororo,
kusoma akizingatia msamiati wa suala lengwa,
kusikiliza mashairi yanayokaririwa kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali,
kusoma au kukariri shairi kwa mahadhi mbalimbali akizingatia ujumbe,
kushiriki mjadala kuhusu ujumbe unaojitokeza kwenye shairi,
kusoma mashairi kwenye mitandao.
key_inquiry_questions: Unaufahamu msamiati gani wa ushairi?
Mashairi yanaweza kuwasilisha ujumbe gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kazi za vikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kufanikisha somo.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoimba au kukariri shairi.
sub_strands.values: Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikikiana na wenzake katika majadiliano yanayohusu shairi bila ubaguzi. Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kufanikisha somo kwa uangalifu.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya kijinsia: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake kusoma na kukariri mashairi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya nyimbo na ushairi katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English, Creative Arts na Religious Education.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ushauri nasaha na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Religious Education.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya shairi, ubeti na mshororo ili kuvibainisha
kusoma shairi kwa ufasaha kwa kuzingatia ujumbe
kutambua beti na mishororo katika shairi
kutambua shairi kutokana na umbo lake
kufurahia kutumia lugha ya ushairi anapozungumzia ushairi

skills.name: Tambua shairi, ubeti na mshororo
skills.mastery: Says what a shairi, an ubeti and a mshororo are, counts the beti and the mishororo in a short poem, and tells a poem from a paragraph by its shape, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Reading a poem for its message builds on reading a story for its message.
Reading aloud clearly is needed for reading a poem with its beat.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Swaps ubeti (a group of lines) and mshororo (one line).

example.question: Mstari mmoja wa shairi huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows both words but not which is which.
misconceptions.reveals: Both words as options.
misconceptions.help: One line, or a group of lines?
misconceptions.feedback: Mshororo ni mstari mmoja wa shairi. Ubeti ni kundi la mishororo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Counts the lines of the whole poem for the lines of one ubeti (or the reverse).

example.question: Ubeti wa pili wa shairi hili una mishororo mingapi?

misconceptions.cause: The child counts all the lines.
misconceptions.reveals: A question about one ubeti with the total as an option.
misconceptions.help: Count only the lines of that ubeti.
misconceptions.feedback: Ubeti ni kundi moja la mishororo. Hesabu mishororo ya ubeti huo tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a paragraph for a poem, or a poem for a paragraph.

example.question: Ni maandishi yapi ni shairi?
example.wrong_answer: Aya moja ndefu inayoendelea hadi mwisho wa ukurasa

misconceptions.cause: The child does not look at the shape on the page.
misconceptions.reveals: A poem and a paragraph described by their shape.
misconceptions.help: How are the lines laid out?
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi lina mishororo mifupi iliyopangwa katika beti. Kifungu cha kawaida kina aya ndefu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a poem straight on like a story, with no pause at the end of each line.

example.question: Unasoma shairi. Unasimama wapi kidogo?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads every text the same way.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasoma shairi. Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "mwisho wa shairi tu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the end of each mshororo while reading together.
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi husomwa mshororo kwa mshororo, ukisimama kidogo mwisho wa kila mmoja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,

kuandika insha ya maelezo kuhusu suala lengwa (ushauri-nasaha) akitumia vivumishi na vielezi vifaavyo, kutoa picha dhahiri kuhusu anachokielezea akizingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,
kushiriki na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya maelezo,
kuandika insha ya maelezo daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali na kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake na mwalimu ili kuitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Insha ya maelezo inahusu nini?
Unazingatia nini unapoandika insha ya maelezo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi za vikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kusambaza insha mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo.
sub_strands.values:
Uadilifu: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika na kusambaza kazi yake mtandaoni kwa uangalifu.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoiandika ili kuitathmini.
sub_strands.pcis: Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapofanya shughuli ya kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya maelezo pamoja na wenzake.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya uandishi wa insha ya maelezo katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ushauri nasaha na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Religious Education.

outcomes.text: kutambua vifungu vya maelezo katika matini
kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wa insha ya maelezo ili kujenga ubunifu wake

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya maelezo
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes an explanation or description on the topic, in order, with detail that makes a picture and no point off the topic; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Telling the kinds of insha and their parts comes before writing one.
The parts of a describing insha were met in Grade 3.

misconceptions.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kumsaidia Rafiki Mwenye Huzuni"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, msikilize kwa makini bila kumcheka.

misconceptions.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kumsaidia Rafiki Mwenye Huzuni"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kumsaidia Rafiki Mwenye Huzuni"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, msikilize kwa makini bila kumcheka.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kumsaidia Rafiki Mwenye Huzuni"?" with "Rafiki ni mtu mzuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kumsaidia Rafiki Mwenye Huzuni"?
example.wrong_answer: mwambie mtu mzima, mpe ushauri, mfariji, msikilize
example.correct_answer: msikilize, mfariji, mpe ushauri, mwambie mtu mzima

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kumsaidia Rafiki Mwenye Huzuni"?" with "mwambie mtu mzima, mpe ushauri, mfariji, msikilize" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
misconceptions.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kumsaidia Rafiki Mwenye Huzuni", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, msikilize kwa makini bila kumcheka.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kumsaidia Rafiki Mwenye Huzuni", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kusoma sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya U-I katika umoja na wingi,
kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-I kwenye sentensi alizosoma,
kushiriki katika mchezo wa kuchopoa kadi za sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya U-I kutoka kwenye kikapu au boksi na kisha kuzisoma,
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya U-I kwenye kadi, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu maneno,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia viambishi vya umoja na wingi wa nomino katika ngeli ya U-I,
kuunda sentensi sahihi daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akitumia nomino za ngeli ya U-I katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi,
kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake na mwalimu sentensi alizozitunga ili kuzitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Nomino zinazorejelea mimea na vitu vya kimaumbile ni zipi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi kuandika nomino za ngeli ya U-I katika umoja na wingi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi kwa kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-I katika umoja na wingi.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapowaza kwa kina kuhusu nomino zilizo katika ngeli ya U-I.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza tarakilishi na vifaa vingine anavyotumia.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kuorodhesha nomino kuhusu suala lengwa.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapozingatia hatua za kiusalama kutambua nomino za ngeli ya U-I kwenye tarakilishi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ngeli za nomino katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la ushauri nasaha na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Religious Education.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya U-I
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya U-I ili kuzitofautisha na nomino katika ngeli nyingine
kuunda sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya U-I, katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya U-I katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya U-I kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to U-I (mti, mlango, mkono, mkoba, mguu), gives u- for one and i- for many, and makes the plural noun (mti-miti), without using the prefix of people, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Singular and plural sentences are where the u-/i- change is seen.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses i- with one noun of U-I.

example.question: Mti mmoja ___meanguka.

misconceptions.cause: The child has fixed i- as the prefix of U-I.
misconceptions.reveals: One and many in turn.
misconceptions.help: Count: one or many?
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za U-I hutumia u- kwa umoja: mti umeanguka. Hutumia i- kwa wingi: miti imeanguka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses u- with many nouns of U-I.

example.question: Miti miwili ___meanguka.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not look at the number.
misconceptions.reveals: Plural nouns that begin with mi-.
misconceptions.help: Mi- tells you it is many.
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi wa mti ni miti, na kiambishi ni i-: miti imeanguka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a noun of U-I the prefix of people (mti anaanguka).

example.question: Mlango mmoja ___mefunguka.

misconceptions.cause: The child sees m- and thinks of mtoto and mwalimu.
misconceptions.reveals: U-I nouns that begin with m- like people nouns.
misconceptions.help: Is it a person? A tree and a door are things.
misconceptions.feedback: Mti na mlango ni vitu, si watu. Vinatumia u- na i-, si a- na wa-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts a noun of another class in U-I.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya U-I?

misconceptions.cause: The child sees m- and takes any noun that begins with it.
misconceptions.reveals: Nouns that begin with m- from different classes.
misconceptions.help: Is it a person or an animal? Then it is A-WA, not U-I.
misconceptions.feedback: Mtoto ni mtu, kwa hiyo yuko A-WA. Mti ni kitu na uko U-I.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Makes the plural noun with a prefix of another class (mamti, wamlango for miti, milango).

example.question: Mti mmoja, ___ miwili.

misconceptions.cause: The child puts on a prefix from another class.
misconceptions.reveals: Nouns of U-I in the plural.
misconceptions.help: m- becomes mi- for things of this class.
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi wa nomino za U-I huanza kwa mi-: mti-miti, mlango-milango, mkono-mikono, mguu-miguu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kukariri shairi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi na mahadhi mbalimbali,
kusikiliza shairi kuhusu suala lengwa likikaririwa au kuimbwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa (mghani) au kupitia vifaa vya kidijitali,
kushirikiana na wenzake kukariri au kuimba shairi kwa mahadhi mbalimbali,
kutambua msamiati uliotumika katika ushairi kuhusu maadili (k.v. uhuru, bendera, rangi za bendera, kupandisha na kushukisha bendera) na kuueleza akiwa peke yake au kwa kushirikiana na wenzake,
kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili ujumbe katika shairi,
kujibu maswali yanayotokana na shairi alilosikiliza, aliloimba au kukariri.
key_inquiry_questions: Mashairi yana umuhimu gani katika jamii?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za vikundi kukariri na kuimba shairi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza shairi lililorekodiwa likikaririwa kupitia vyombo vya kidijitali.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapojenga umilisi huu anapokariri shairi.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kujadili ujumbe na matukio katika shairi na kuheshimu mchango wao.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki majukumu tofautitofauti katika vikundi na kufuata mafunzo katika shairi.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kitaifa: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kukariri shairi kuhusu bendera ya taifa kwa mahadhi na kutambua msamiati uliotumika.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ushairi katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la bendera ya taifa na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kukariri au kuimba shairi kwa kuzingatia matamshi na mahadhi mbalimbali
kueleza maana ya msamiati uliotumiwa katika shairi
kutumia msamiati uliotumiwa katika shairi ili kuboresha mawasiliano
kueleza ujumbe wa shairi ili kudhihirisha ufahamu wake
kuchangamkia ushairi kama njia ya kujieleza kwa ufasaha

skills.name: Elewa msamiati wa shairi la taifa
skills.mastery: Gives the meaning of the words of a poem about the nation (bendera, taifa, uhuru, shujaa, mshikamano, amani) and uses them in a sentence, without choosing a look-alike or an opposite word, in 8 of 10 new items. Reciting is a teacher's check.

prerequisites.reason: Knowing what a shairi, ubeti and mshororo are comes before reciting and explaining one.
Working out a word from the line around it is the same work as in a passage.

misconceptions.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word.

example.question: Neno "taifa" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child goes by the sound.
misconceptions.reveals: A look-alike word as an option.
misconceptions.help: Say what each word means.
misconceptions.feedback: Maneno yanaweza kusikika sawa na yasiwe na maana sawa. Taifa ni nchi na watu wake.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word of the same family of ideas.

example.question: Neno "bendera" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child picks an idea close to the nation.
misconceptions.reveals: Another symbol of the nation as an option.
misconceptions.help: What can you see, touch and hoist?
misconceptions.feedback: Bendera ni kitambaa chenye rangi kinachoonyesha nchi. Wimbo wa taifa ni wimbo rasmi wa nchi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks the opposite.

example.question: Neno "amani" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the topic but not which way it points.
misconceptions.reveals: The opposite meaning as an option.
misconceptions.help: Does the word mean the thing is there, or not?
misconceptions.feedback: Amani ni hali ya utulivu bila vita. Vita ni kinyume cha amani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a line of the poem as its message, or says the message is "the flag" (the topic).

example.question: Ujumbe wa shairi kuhusu bendera ya taifa ni upi?
example.correct_answer: tuipende na kuiheshimu bendera ya nchi yetu

misconceptions.cause: The topic is the clearest thing in the poem; the child has not been asked what the poet wants.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa shairi kuhusu bendera ya taifa ni upi?" with "bendera" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: what does the poet want us to feel or do about the flag?
misconceptions.feedback: Mada ni bendera; ujumbe ni kile mshairi anataka tufanye: tuiheshimu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 6: Bendera ya taifa)
learning_experiences: kusoma makala ya aina mbalimbali (k.m hadithi fupi, michezo mifupi, mashairi mafupi) akizingatia vipengele kama vile tahajia, sarufi, wahusika na ujumbe kutoka kwa kitabu, gazeti au blogi,
kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu makala aliyoyasoma na umuhimu wake,
kutumia kamusi kupata maana za msamiati uliotumika katika makala.
key_inquiry_questions: Kusoma hadithi kuna umuhimu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake katika vikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anaposoma makala katika blogi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia kamusi kupata maana za msamiati mpya uliotumika katika Makala.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu makala aliyoyasoma na umuhimu wake.
Uzalendo: mwanafunzi anaposoma makala kuhusu jamii mbalimbali na kuheshimu mafunzo yanayojitokeza.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kujadili kuhusu makala aliyoyasoma na umuhimu wake.
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapozingatia hatua za kiusalama anaposoma makala ya blogi mtandaoni.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa kina katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la uraia mwema na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kusoma makala kwa kuzingatia vipengele mbalimbali vinavyoyajenga
kusoma na kutambua umuhimu wa ujumbe wa makala husika
kufurahia kusoma makala mbalimbali ili kukuza ufahamu

skills.name: Elewa ujumbe wa makala
skills.mastery: Answers questions about a short article (makala) from what it says, and gives its main message, without choosing a detail for the message or an answer from outside the article, in 8 of 10 new questions.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
New words of the article are worked out from the sentence.

misconceptions.error: Answers from what the child knows, not from the article.

example.question: Kwa mujibu wa makala, maji yachemshwe kwa muda gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child gives the figure he has heard.
misconceptions.reveals: A likely figure that the article does not give.
misconceptions.help: Point to the sentence in the article.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu la swali la makala liko ndani ya makala. Tafuta sentensi inayolisema.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a detail for the main message of the article.

example.question: Ujumbe mkuu wa makala ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kunywa maji safi na salama.

misconceptions.cause: The child takes one sentence.
misconceptions.reveals: A detail and a message as options.
misconceptions.help: What is the whole article for?
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe mkuu unatokana na makala nzima, si sentensi moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks another detail of the article.

example.question: Makala inasema maji yawekwe wapi baada ya kuchemshwa?

misconceptions.cause: The child picks a detail from the right place, not the one asked.
misconceptions.reveals: Several details from one paragraph.
misconceptions.help: Read the question word again.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma swali tena na utafute sehemu ya makala inayolijibu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the title of the article as its message.

example.question: Makala "Bendera Yetu" yana ujumbe upi?
example.correct_answer: tuiheshimu bendera kwa sababu inawakilisha nchi yetu

misconceptions.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole article the child is sure of.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Makala "Bendera Yetu" yana ujumbe upi?" with "Bendera Yetu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to know or do after reading.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni kile mwandishi anataka ujue au ufanye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha ya Wasifu (Theme 6: Bendera ya taifa)
learning_experiences: kutambua insha ya wasifu kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,

kuandika insha inayoeleza sifa za mtu kama vile mzazi au mlezi, rafiki, mwalimu au kiongozi yeyote (kwa kutumia vivumishi na vielezi ili kujenga picha dhahiri ya anachokiandikia) daftarini kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,
kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya wasifu,
kuandika insha ya wasifu mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Insha ya wasifu inahusu nini?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: wanafunzi wanaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi za vikundi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya wasifu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafakari swali dadisi na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia
sub_strands.values:
tarakilishi.
Heshima: mwanfunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kufanikisha shughuli za kikundi kwa kuthamini maoni yao.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuisambaza insha yake mtandaoni ili mwalimu au wenzake waitathmini.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni.
sub_strands.pcis: Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha yake mtandaoni na kujitolea kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya uandishi wa insha katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la bendera na uraia na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua insha ya wasifu kwa kuzingatia muundo
kuandika insha ya wasifu kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo akizingatia vivumishi na vielezi kujenga picha dhahiri ya anachokielezea
kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wa insha ya wasifu ili kukuza ubunifu

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya wasifu
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya wasifu from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a description of a person, place or thing with describing words that agree with their nouns and no story of events; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Telling the kinds of insha and their parts comes before writing one.
The first wasifu was written in Theme 1.

misconceptions.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should describe the person, place or thing.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Bendera ya Taifa Letu"?
example.correct_answer: Bendera yetu ina rangi nne: nyeusi, nyekundu, kijani na nyeupe.

misconceptions.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Bendera ya Taifa Letu"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it looks like, what it is for.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya wasifu hueleza jinsi kitu au mtu alivyo, si matukio ya siku moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Bendera ya Taifa Letu"?
example.correct_answer: Bendera yetu ina rangi nne: nyeusi, nyekundu, kijani na nyeupe.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Bendera ya Taifa Letu"?" with "Bendera yetu ni nzuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a describing word that does not agree with its noun (bendera mzuri, miti mrefu).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?

misconceptions.cause: The child uses one form of the adjective (m-) for every noun, as he hears it for people.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni sahihi?" with "Bendera yetu ni mzuri sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Find the noun first, then its ngeli, then the prefix of the adjective.
misconceptions.feedback: Kivumishi hupatana na nomino yake: bendera nzuri, miti mirefu, mtoto mzuri.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Bendera ya Taifa Letu", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Bendera yetu ina rangi nne: nyeusi, nyekundu, kijani na nyeupe.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya wasifu yenye anwani "Bendera ya Taifa Letu", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli ya LI- YA (Theme 6: Bendera ya taifa)
learning_experiences: kusoma sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA katika umoja na wingi,
kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya LI-YA kwenye sentensi alizosoma,
kushiriki katika mchezo wa kuchopoa kadi za sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA kutoka kwenye kikapu au boksi na kisha kuzisoma,
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya LI-YA kwenye kadi, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu maneno,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia viambishi vya umoja na wingi wa nomino katika ngeli ya LI-YA,
kuunda sentensi sahihi daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akitumia nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi,
kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake na mwalimu sentensi alizozitunga ili kuzitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini ili kuweza kutambua na kutumia nomino katika ngeli ya LI-YA?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga mafungu ya maneno.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapowaza kwa kina kuhusu atakachoandika.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutambua nomino na katika kusikiliza mafungu kwenye tepurekoda.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za vikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza kipakatalishi anachotumia.
Uzalendo: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wengine kwenye vikundi bila ubaguzi wa kijamii.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali ili kutekeleza kazi ya
sub_strands.pcis:
kikundi.
Umoja na wenzake: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutambua na kuandika nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA.
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapozingatia hatua za kiusalama anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha ya wasifu.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ngeli za nomino katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la uraia na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya LI-YA
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya LI -YA ili kuzitofautisha na nomino katika ngeli nyingine
kuunda sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA, katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya LI-YA kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to LI-YA (jiwe, jicho, tunda, embe, dirisha, jina), gives li- for one and ya- for many, and makes the plural noun with ma- (jiwe-mawe, tunda-matunda), in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
The child must find the noun before giving it its class prefix.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses ya- with one noun of LI-YA.

example.question: Jiwe moja ___meanguka.

misconceptions.cause: The child has fixed ya- as the prefix of LI-YA.
misconceptions.reveals: One and many in turn.
misconceptions.help: Count: one or many?
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za LI-YA hutumia li- kwa umoja: jiwe limeanguka. Hutumia ya- kwa wingi: mawe yameanguka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses li- with many nouns of LI-YA.

example.question: Mawe mawili ___meanguka.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not see that ma- tells it is many.
misconceptions.reveals: Plural nouns that begin with ma-.
misconceptions.help: Ma- tells you it is many.
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi wa jiwe ni mawe, na kiambishi ni ya-: mawe yameanguka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Makes the plural with the wrong form (majiwe, majicho for mawe, macho).

example.question: Jicho moja, ___ mawili.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds ma- and keeps ji-.
misconceptions.reveals: Nouns that begin with ji-.
misconceptions.help: ji- becomes ma-: jiwe-mawe, jicho-macho.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za LI-YA zinazoanza na ji- hupoteza ji- katika wingi: jiwe-mawe, jicho-macho. Nyingine hupata ma-: tunda-matunda.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts a noun of another class in LI-YA.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya LI-YA?

misconceptions.cause: The child goes by the first letters only.
misconceptions.reveals: Nouns from other classes with a look-alike beginning.
misconceptions.help: Does it form its plural with ma-?
misconceptions.feedback: Kiti kiko katika ngeli ya KI-VI (viti). Jiwe liko LI-YA (mawe).
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a noun of LI-YA the prefix of another class (kimeanguka for limeanguka).

example.question: Jiwe moja ___meanguka.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not tell which class the noun belongs to.
misconceptions.reveals: Several prefixes as options.
misconceptions.help: Which class has the plural with ma-? Its prefixes are li- and ya-.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za LI-YA hutumia li- kwa umoja na ya- kwa wingi, si ki-, vi-, u- wala i-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua nahau za maadili na uraia (k.v fanya haki, omba kibali, omba ruhusa, piga hodi na taka idhini) katika chati, michoro, picha, kapu maneno, mti maneno, chati na katika vyombo vya kidijitali,
kushiriki katika kujadili na wenzake maana za nahau za maadili na uraia,
kutumia nahau za maadili na uraia kutunga sentensi akiwa pekee yake au kwa kushirikiana na wenzake,
kutazama vibonzo vikijibizana kuhusu nahau na maana zake,
kushirikiana na wenzake kuteua nahau za maadili na uraia kutoka kwenye kundi la nahau.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, nahau huchangia vipi katika kukuza maadili na uraia?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadili maana za nahau za maadili na uraia akiwa na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutambua nahau za maadili na uraia.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafuta maana za nahau na kuzitumia kwa ufasaha katika mawasiliano.
Uraia: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kujadili masuala ya uraia na yanayolenga suala lengwa.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia katika kutambua nahau za maadili na za uraia.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kufanikisha kazi ya kikundi na kuheshimu maoni yao.
sub_strands.pcis: Umoja wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika majadiliano kwa vikundi wanapotunga sentensi kwa kutumia nahau za maadili na uraia.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya nahau katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la matunda na mimea na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Agriculture

outcomes.text: kutambua nahau za maadili na uraia katika matini mbalimbali
kutambua maana za nahau mbalimbali za maadili na uraia katika mazungumzo
kutumia nahau za maadili na uraia katika mawasiliano
kuthamini matumizi ya nahau za maadili na uraia katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na eleza maana ya nahau za maadili na uraia
skills.mastery: Tells a nahau from other sayings and gives what it means (kupiga moyo konde, kujikaza kisabuni, kula kiapo, kukata tamaa), without taking it word for word, in 8 of 10 new items. Using it aloud is a teacher's check.

prerequisites.reason: A methali also says one thing and means another; it is met first.
Most nahau are built on a verb (kupiga, kuvunja, kuweka).

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Takes the nahau word for word.

example.question: Nahau "kupiga moyo konde" ina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads the words and not the meaning.
misconceptions.reveals: A literal meaning as an option.
misconceptions.help: Can the words mean what they say?
misconceptions.feedback: Nahau ni maneno yenye maana tofauti na maneno yenyewe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the meaning of another nahau.

example.question: Nahau "kula kiapo" ina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the topic but mixes the phrases.
misconceptions.reveals: Meanings of two nahau on the same topic.
misconceptions.help: Which words of the phrase does the meaning explain?
misconceptions.feedback: Kila nahau ina maana yake. Linganisha maneno ya nahau na maana kabla ya kuchagua.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a methali or an ordinary phrase for a nahau.

example.question: Ni nahau ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not tell a nahau from a methali.
misconceptions.reveals: A nahau among methali and phrases.
misconceptions.help: Is it a short phrase that is not a whole saying with a lesson?
misconceptions.feedback: Nahau ni kifungu kifupi chenye maana maalum. Methali ni sentensi nzima yenye funzo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Changes a word of the nahau (kupiga moyo kubwa for kupiga moyo konde).

example.question: Alipiga moyo ___ akaendelea kusoma.

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the sense but not the exact words.
misconceptions.reveals: A gap in a nahau with plausible words.
misconceptions.help: Which word goes with the others in this phrase?
misconceptions.feedback: Nahau hutumia maneno yale yale: kupiga moyo konde, kujikaza kisabuni, kula kiapo, kukata tamaa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 7: Matunda na mimea)
learning_experiences: kutambua matini (k.v vitabu, majarida, magazeti) yanayomvutia maktabani na mtandaoni,
kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa,
