kuwasimulia wenzake kuhusu matini aliyosoma ili kupashana ujumbe na kuchocheana kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha,
kujadiliana na wenzake matini ambayo wamesoma.
key_inquiry_questions: Kusoma matini mbalimbali kunachangia vipi ukuzaji wa lugha?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposimulia wenzake kuhusu matini aliyoisoma ili kupasha ujumbe na kuchocheana kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia mtandao kupata matini ya kusoma.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojichagulia matini na kuyasoma.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anaposimulia wenzake kuhusu matini aliyosoma na kupasha ujumbe uliotumiwa.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza tarakilishi anayoitumia katika kutambua matini.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu alichokisoma na kusikiliza maoni ya kila mmoja wao.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya afya ya kujikinga: mwanafunzi anapotambua na kusoma matini yanayomvutia maktabani akizingatia suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa mapana katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la matunda na mimea na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Agriculture

outcomes.text: kutambua matini ya aina mbalimbali ya kusoma na kuchagua yanayomvutia
kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa
kufurahia usomaji wa aina mbalimbali za matini

skills.name: Chagua matini ya kusoma na ueleze ujumbe wake
skills.mastery: Chooses a text that suits his reading level and interest from its title, blurb and first page (not from the cover alone), tells the kind of text (hadithi, shairi, makala, gazeti), says its message in one sentence, and works out a new word from the sentence around it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Finding the message of a story read in class comes before choosing and reading alone.
Working out new words from the sentence is needed when reading alone.

misconceptions.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu matunda na mimea. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

misconceptions.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu matunda na mimea. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Mti wa Mwembe wa Bibi" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Mti wa Mwembe wa Bibi" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
misconceptions.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Mti wa Mwembe wa Bibi" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukipanda na kutunza miti, itatufaa sisi na watoto wetu.

misconceptions.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Mti wa Mwembe wa Bibi" ni upi?" with "Mti wa Mwembe wa Bibi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu matunda na mimea?
example.wrong_answer: Bibi alipanda mwembe miaka mingi iliyopita.
example.correct_answer: Tukipanda na kutunza miti, itatufaa sisi na watoto wetu.

misconceptions.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu matunda na mimea?" with "Bibi alipanda mwembe miaka mingi iliyopita." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (kivuli).

example.question: Katika matini: "Watoto walikaa chini ya kivuli cha mwembe wakati wa jua kali." Neno "kivuli" lina maana gani?
example.correct_answer: mahali pasipo na jua chini ya mti

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Watoto walikaa chini ya kivuli cha mwembe wakati wa jua kali." Neno "kivuli" lina maana gani?" with "kivuko cha mto" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "kivuli" hapa ni mahali pasipo na jua chini ya mti.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha ya Maelezo (Theme 7: Matunda na mimea)
learning_experiences: kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kushiriki na wenzake kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya maelezo,
kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,

kuandika insha ya maelezo akizingatia suala lengwa (k.v upanzi wa miti na mimea, utunzaji wa mimea, shamba la matunda n.k) hasa akizingatia vivumishi na vielezi vifaavyo kutoa picha dhahiri kuhusu anachokielezea,

kuandika insha ya maelezo akizingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu inayojumuisha methali na nahau alizojifunza awali,
kuandika insha ya maelezo mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waisikilize na kuitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni vitu gani vinavyoweza kuandikiwa insha ya maelezo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mjadala wa kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya maelezo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo akizingatia suala lengwa.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafakari kuhusu swali dadisi na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya maelezo.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha na kuwasambazia wenzake waitathmini.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo akizingatia suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika insha ya maelezo katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la matunda na mimea na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Agriculture

outcomes.text: kutambua insha ya maelezo katika matini
kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wa insha ya maelezo ili kukuza ubunifu

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya maelezo
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes an explanation or description on the topic, in order, with detail that makes a picture and no point off the topic; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Telling the kinds of insha and their parts comes before writing one.
The first maelezo was written in Theme 5.

misconceptions.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, chimba shimo lenye kina cha futi mbili.

misconceptions.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, chimba shimo lenye kina cha futi mbili.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti"?" with "Miti ni mizuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti"?
example.wrong_answer: mwagilia maji, funika kwa udongo, weka mche, chimba shimo
example.correct_answer: chimba shimo, weka mche, funika kwa udongo, mwagilia maji

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti"?" with "mwagilia maji, funika kwa udongo, weka mche, chimba shimo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
misconceptions.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, chimba shimo lenye kina cha futi mbili.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kupanda Mti", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli ya KI-VI (Theme 7: Matunda na mimea)
learning_experiences: kusoma sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika umoja na wingi,
kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya KI-VI kwenye sentensi alizosoma,
kushiriki katika mchezo wa kuchopoa kadi za sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI kutoka kwenye kikapu au boksi na kisha kuzisoma,
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya KI-VI (k.m kitabu, kikombe, kisu, chakula, choo) kwenye kadi, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu maneno,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia viambishi vya umoja na wingi wa nomino katika ngeli ya KI-VI,
kuunda sentensi sahihi daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akitumia nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi,
kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake na mwalimu sentensi alizozitunga ili kuzitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini ili kuweza kutambua na kutumia nomino katika ngeli ya KI-VI?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapotaja nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kutunga sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika umoja na wingi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kusoma sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika umoja na wingi.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia na kutunza tarakilishi anaposoma sentensi zilizotungwa kutokana na nomino za KI-VI.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapotaja nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake kwa vikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ngeli za nomino katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la matunda na mimea na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Agriculture

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya KI-VI
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya KI-VI ili kuzitofautisha na nomino katika ngeli nyingine
kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KI-VI katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya KI-VI kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to KI-VI (kitabu, kiti, kikombe, kisu, kiatu), gives ki- for one and vi- for many, and makes the plural noun (kitabu-vitabu, kiatu-viatu), in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
The ki-/vi- change is first met in singular and plural sentences.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses vi- with one noun of KI-VI.

example.question: Kiti kimoja ___meanguka.

misconceptions.cause: The child has fixed vi- as the prefix of KI-VI.
misconceptions.reveals: One and many in turn.
misconceptions.help: Count: one or many?
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za KI-VI hutumia ki- kwa umoja: kiti kimeanguka. Hutumia vi- kwa wingi: viti vimeanguka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses ki- with many nouns of KI-VI.

example.question: Viti viwili ___meanguka.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not see that the noun is plural.
misconceptions.reveals: Plural nouns that begin with vi-.
misconceptions.help: Vi- tells you it is many.
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi wa kiti ni viti, na kiambishi ni vi-: viti vimeanguka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Makes the plural noun by adding a prefix and keeping ki- (vikitabu, vikiatu).

example.question: Kitabu kimoja, ___ viwili.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds vi- in front and does not drop ki-.
misconceptions.reveals: Nouns of KI-VI in the plural.
misconceptions.help: ki- is replaced by vi-, not added to.
misconceptions.feedback: Katika wingi, ki- hubadilika kuwa vi-: kitabu-vitabu, kiatu-viatu, kikombe-vikombe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts a noun of another class in KI-VI.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya KI-VI?

misconceptions.cause: The child sees a k in the word and thinks of ki-.
misconceptions.reveals: Nouns of other classes with a k in them.
misconceptions.help: Does the noun begin with ki-, and is its plural vi-?
misconceptions.feedback: Kikombe-vikombe ni KI-VI. Jiwe-mawe ni LI-YA.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a noun of KI-VI the prefix of another class (limeanguka for kimeanguka).

example.question: Kiti kimoja ___meanguka.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not tell which class the noun belongs to.
misconceptions.reveals: Several prefixes as options.
misconceptions.help: The noun begins with ki- or vi-. Its prefixes are ki- and vi-.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za KI-VI hutumia ki- kwa umoja na vi- kwa wingi, si li-, ya-, u- wala i-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Ngeli ya LI-LI (Theme 7: Matunda na mimea)
learning_experiences: kusoma sentensi zilizoundwa kutokana na nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI katika umoja na wingi,
kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya LI-LI kwenye sentensi alizosoma,
kushiriki katika mchezo wa kuchopoa kadi za sentensi zenye nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI kutoka kwenye kikapu au boksi na kisha kuzisoma,
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya LI-LI (k.m jua- jua, giza-giza) kwenye kadi maneno, mti maneno, tarakilishi au kapu maneno,
kuandika nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI katika umoja na wingi,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia viambishi vya umoja na wingi wa nomino katika ngeli ya LI-LI,
kuunda sentensi sahihi daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali akitumia nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi,
kuwasomea au kuwasambazia wenzake na mwalimu sentensi alizozitunga ili kuzitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini ili kuweza kutambua na kutumia nomino katika ngeli ya LI-LI?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga mafungu ya maneno kutokana na ngeli ya LI-LI katika umoja na wingi.
Kufikiri kwa kina: mwanafunzi anapowaza kwa kina kuhusu atakachoandika.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua nomino katika kusikiliza mafungu ya maneno yakisomwa.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza kipakatalishi anachokitumia.
Uzalendo: mwanafunzi anapofanya kazi na wengine kwenye vikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapoandika nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI katika umoja na wingi na wenzake bila ubaguzi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ngeli za nomino katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la matunda na mimea na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya upatanisho wa kisarufi wa ngeli ya LI-LI
kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya LI-LI ili kuzitofautisha na nomino katika ngeli nyingine
kuunda sentensi akitumia nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI, katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
kuchangamkia kutumia nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia ngeli ya LI-LI kwa upatanisho wa kisarufi
skills.mastery: Knows the nouns the design gives for LI-LI (jua, giza), whose noun has the same form for one and for many, and uses li- with them (jua limetoka, giza limeingia), without using the prefix of another class, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
The noun must be found before its class prefix is chosen.

misconceptions.error: Uses ya- with jua or giza because of the ma- plural of LI-YA.

example.question: Jua ___metoka asubuhi.

misconceptions.cause: The child carries the LI-YA rule over to nouns that do not change.
misconceptions.reveals: The nouns jua and giza in turn.
misconceptions.help: The noun does not change. What does the sentence tell you?
misconceptions.feedback: Jua na giza ni nomino za ngeli ya LI-LI: kiambishi ni li-: jua limetoka, giza limeingia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives jua or giza the prefix of another class (u- or i-).

example.question: Giza ___meingia haraka.

misconceptions.cause: The child hears jua or giza as a thing of the U-I class.
misconceptions.reveals: Jua and giza with several prefixes.
misconceptions.help: Which class does the design put jua and giza in?
misconceptions.feedback: Jua na giza ni LI-LI: vinatumia li-.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts a noun of another class in LI-LI.

example.question: Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya LI-LI?

misconceptions.cause: The child has few examples of LI-LI to compare.
misconceptions.reveals: Jua or giza among nouns of other classes.
misconceptions.help: Which of them is in the class the design names?
misconceptions.feedback: Kati ya nomino hizi, jua na giza ndizo za LI-LI. Mti uko U-I.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Makes a plural for a noun of LI-LI (majua, magiza).

example.question: Wingi wa "jua" katika "Jua limewaka" ni upi?

misconceptions.cause: Most li- nouns the child knows (jiwe/mawe) have a ma- plural.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "jua" katika "Jua limewaka" ni upi?" with "majua" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show that there is only one sun: the noun and its prefix stay li- in both.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino za LI-LI hazibadiliki katika wingi: jua limewaka.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya neno kisawe akiwa na wenzake,

kutambua maneno mawili ya kiwango chake yenye maana sawa (k.v tembo, ndovu; kinyonga, lumbwi; adui, hasimu; siri, faragha; barua, waraka; ami, amu; televisheni, runinga) kwa kurejelea kapu maneno, kadi maneno na mti maneno,
kuambatanisha visawe kutoka kwenye kapu maneno, mti maneno, orodha ya maneno, chati, vyombo vya kidijitali au kadi maneno,
kutumia kisawe kimoja kuchukua nafasi ya kingine katika sentensi,
kutumia kisawe kimoja kuchukua nafasi ya kingine katika kifungu kifupi.
key_inquiry_questions: Maneno yenye maana sawa yanasaidia vipi katika mawasiliano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wengine kueleza maana ya neno kisawe kwa kujadiliana.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapofikiria kuhusu visawe mwafaka na uhusiano wa visawe na vifaa halisi
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kama nyenzo za kufaulisha mada.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na wenzake kujadili visawe mbalimbali katika vikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotekeleza majukumu yao katika vikundi vilevile kutunza vifaa anavyotumia katika somo.
sub_strands.pcis: Umoja wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili visawe mbalimbali darasani.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya visawe katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la wanyama wa porini na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya kisawe ili kukibainisha
kutambua maneno mawili yenye maana sawa katika matini
kutumia visawe ifaavyo katika mawasiliano
kuthamini matumizi ya visawe katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua visawe
skills.mastery: Picks the word with the same meaning (haraka-upesi, shida-taabu, furaha-raha) and does not choose a look-alike, an opposite or a related word, in 8 of 10 new items. Using visawe aloud is a teacher's check.

prerequisites.reason: The child must know the meaning of a word to find another with the same meaning.
Opposites and synonyms are taught side by side; telling them apart is the work.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Picks the opposite.

example.question: Kisawe cha "furaha" ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the topic but not which way it points.
misconceptions.reveals: The opposite as an option.
misconceptions.help: Same meaning, or opposite?
misconceptions.feedback: Kisawe ni neno lenye maana sawa. Kinyume cha furaha ni huzuni, si kisawe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word that looks or sounds like the word.

example.question: Kisawe cha "haraka" ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child goes by the first letters.
misconceptions.reveals: A look-alike word as an option.
misconceptions.help: Say what each word means.
misconceptions.feedback: Maneno yanaweza kuanza kwa herufi zilezile na yasiwe na maana sawa. Kisawe cha haraka ni upesi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a related word that is not the same in meaning.

example.question: Kisawe cha "tajiri" ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child picks a word that goes with the idea.
misconceptions.reveals: A related word as an option.
misconceptions.help: Can you put it in place of the word, with the same meaning?
misconceptions.feedback: Kisawe kinaweza kuchukua mahali pa neno bila kubadilisha maana. Tajiri na mkwasi wana maana sawa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a synonym of another kind of word (a verb for a noun: nyumba - kuishi).

example.question: Kisawe cha "nyumba" ni kipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child links the words by an idea (a house is where you live), not by meaning.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kisawe cha "nyumba" ni kipi?" with "kuishi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Check the synonym can stand in the same sentence in place of the word.
misconceptions.feedback: Kisawe kinaweza kuchukua nafasi ya neno katika sentensi ileile: nyumba / makazi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 8: Wanyama wa porini)
learning_experiences: kushiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu maana za mchezo wa kuigiza, mhusika na maelekezo akiwa na wenzake,
kutambua mchezo wa kuigiza, wahusika na maelekezo katika matini mbalimbali kama vile vitabu, chati na vilevile kwa kutumia tarakilishi,

kutazama mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza ukiigizwa darasani au kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v usalama wa wanyama wa porini, kuzingatia mbio ya uendeshaji wa pikipiki, baiskeli na vyombo vingine vya barabara),
kusoma mchezo wa kuigiza akizingatia maelekezo na ujumbe,
kushiriki mjadala kuhusu ujumbe unaojitokeza kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza,
kusoma mchezo wa kuigiza kwenye mtandao,
kujibu maswali yanayotokana na mchezo wa kuigiza aliosoma.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, wahusika huchangia nini katika mchezo wa kuigiza?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu maana za mchezo wa kuigiza na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotazama mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali.
Uwazaji kina: mwanafunzi anapong’amua ujumbe uliomo kwenye mchezo.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kusoma na kushiriki mjadala kuhusu ujumbe unaojitokeza kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza.
sub_strands.values: Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu maana ya mchezo wa kuigiza akiwa na wenzake na kuthamini mchango wao.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu utunzaji wa wanyama wa porini na elimu ya mazingira.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya michezo ya kuigiza katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la wanyama wa porini na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya mchezo wa kuigiza, mhusika na maelekezo
kutambua mchezo wa kuigiza katika matini
kutambua wahusika na maelekezo katika mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza
kusoma mchezo mfupi wa kuigiza kwa ufasaha kwa kuzingatia ujumbe
kufurahia kusoma michezo na kuiigiza

skills.name: Tambua mchezo wa kuigiza, mhusika na maelekezo
skills.mastery: Tells a short play (igizo) from a story by its shape (the name of the speaker, a colon, the words said), names the speaker of a line, and finds the stage direction in brackets, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Reading a play aloud needs fluent reading.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Takes a line of a story for a line of a play (or the reverse).

example.question: Ni kipi kati ya hivi kinatoka kwenye mchezo wa kuigiza?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not see the name and the colon.
misconceptions.reveals: A play line and a story line side by side.
misconceptions.help: Does the line begin with a name and a colon?
misconceptions.feedback: Igizo huonyesha jina la mhusika, nukta mbili, kisha maneno anayosema. Hadithi huelezwa na msimulizi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the words in brackets for words that are said.

example.question: Ni maelekezo ya jukwaani yapi?

misconceptions.cause: The child reads everything on the page as speech.
misconceptions.reveals: A stage direction among spoken lines.
misconceptions.help: What does the actor do, and what does he say?
misconceptions.feedback: Maelekezo ya jukwaani yako kwenye mabano. Yanamwonyesha muigizaji afanye nini, si aseme nini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Names the wrong speaker of a line.

example.question: Nani alisema, "Nipe kilo mbili za unga"?

misconceptions.cause: The child goes by the name closest to the line.
misconceptions.reveals: A line next to the name of another speaker.
misconceptions.help: The name before the colon is the speaker.
misconceptions.feedback: Jina lililo mbele ya nukta mbili ndilo la mhusika anayesema mstari huo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers from what the child knows, not from the play.

example.question: Atieno alinunua nini dukani?

misconceptions.cause: The child gives a likely answer and does not look in the play.
misconceptions.reveals: A likely answer that the play does not give.
misconceptions.help: Point to the line in the play that says it.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu la swali la igizo liko ndani ya igizo. Tafuta mstari unaolisema.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha ya Masimulizi (Theme 8: Wanyama wa porini)
learning_experiences: kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,

kuandika insha inayosimulia kisa cha tukio linalohusiana na wanyama wa porini kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,
kushiriki na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi,
kuandika insha ya masimulizi mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waisikilize na kuitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Insha ya masimulizi inahusu nini?
Je, unazingatia nini ili kuandika insha nzuri ya masimulizi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya masimulizi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapobuni na kuandika insha ya masimulizi.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuisambaza insha aliyoiandika mtandaoni kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na waitathmini.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha inayosimulia kisa cha tukio linalohusiana na wanyama porini kwa kuzingatia mpangilio ufaao.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya utunzaji wa wanyama: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha inayosimulia kisa cha tukio linalohusiana na wanyama wa porini.
Elimu ya fedha: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akizingatia umuhimu wa wanyama pori.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya uandishi wa insha za masimulizi katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la wanyama wa porini na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kuzingatia muundo
kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wa insha ya masimulizi ili kujenga ubunifu wake

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya masimulizi
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya masimulizi from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a story of events in the past tense, in order, with a title, an opening, a middle and a closing that gives the lesson; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Telling the kinds of insha and their parts comes before writing one.
The first masimulizi was written in Theme 2.

misconceptions.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?
example.wrong_answer: Twiga ni mnyama mrefu kuliko wanyama wote.
example.correct_answer: Tuliona twiga wakila majani ya mti mrefu.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?" with "Twiga ni mnyama mrefu kuliko wanyama wote." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
misconceptions.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?
example.wrong_answer: Tunaona twiga wakila majani ya mti mrefu.
example.correct_answer: Tuliona twiga wakila majani ya mti mrefu.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?" with "Tunaona twiga wakila majani ya mti mrefu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
misconceptions.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?
example.wrong_answer: tulirudi jioni, tuliona wanyama, tulifika mbugani, tuliondoka shuleni
example.correct_answer: tuliondoka shuleni, tulifika mbugani, tuliona wanyama, tulirudi jioni

misconceptions.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?" with "tulirudi jioni, tuliona wanyama, tulifika mbugani, tuliondoka shuleni" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

misconceptions.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Safari ya Mbuga ya Wanyama"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
misconceptions.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Mnyambuliko wa Vitenzi (Theme 8: Wanyama wa porini)
learning_experiences: kushirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana za mnyambuliko wa vitenzi, kauli ya kutenda, kauli ya kutendea na kauli ya kutendwa,
kutambua vitenzi katika kauli za kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa katika chati, jedwali, kapu maneno, mti maneno, ubao na vyombo vya kidijitali,
kunyambua vitenzi katika kauli lengwa akiwa na wenzake,
kutumia vitenzi katika kauli lengwa kwenye sentensi,
kushirikiana na wenzake kujaza nafasi katika jedwali la mnyambuliko wa vitenzi kwenye daftari au kwa kutumia tarakilishi,
kuandika sentensi upya kwa kutumia vitenzi katika kauli mbalimbali akizingatia suala lengwa na pia kuhusu kuendesha vyombo vya usafiri kama baiskeli.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, vitenzi vinaweza kubadilika vipi mwishoni ili kuleta maana mbalimbali?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya mnyambuliko wa vitenzi.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anaponyambua vitenzi katika kauli mbalimbali.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotoa majibu na kuandika sentensi upya kwa kutumia vitenzi katika kauli mbalimbali.
sub_strands.values:
Ushirikiano: unajitokeza mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujaza nafasi katika jedwali la mnyambuliko wa vitenzi kwenye daftari,
Umoja: unajidhihirisha mwanafunzi anaponyambua vitenzi katika kauli lengwa akiwa na wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Umoja wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaponyambua vitenzi katika kauli lengwa akiwa na wenzake.
Elimu ya utunzaji wanyama: mwanafunzi anyambue vitenzi vya kauli lengwa kwa sentensi akizingatia suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya vitenzi katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la wanyama wa porini na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya mnyambuliko wa vitenzi ili kuubainisha
kueleza maana ya kauli za kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa ili kuzitofautisha
kutambua vitenzi katika kauli za kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa katika matini
kutumia vitenzi katika kauli za kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa ipasavyo anapowasiliana
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vitenzi katika kauli za kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa kwenye mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na tumia kauli za kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa
skills.mastery: Tells the three verb forms apart (kutenda: andika, kutendea: andikia, done for someone, kutendwa: andikwa, done to the thing) and picks the one a sentence needs, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
The extended verb keeps its tense marker, so tenses come first.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Leaves the verb in its base form where someone is helped (anaandika for anamwandikia).

example.question: Mwalimu ___ wanafunzi barua.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not see that the verb has to show for whom.
misconceptions.reveals: A sentence with a person who benefits.
misconceptions.help: Is it done for someone? Then the verb ends in -ia or -ea.
misconceptions.feedback: Kauli ya kutendea huonyesha kitendo kinafanyiwa mtu: anawaandikia, anampikia, anamsomea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves the verb active where the thing is done to (barua imeandika na mwalimu).

example.question: Barua ___ na mwalimu.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not see that the thing, not the person, is the subject.
misconceptions.reveals: A sentence that begins with the thing that was done.
misconceptions.help: Does the thing do it, or is it done to the thing? Then -wa.
misconceptions.feedback: Kauli ya kutendwa huonyesha kitu kimefanyiwa kitendo: barua imeandikwa, chai imepikwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes -ia (for someone) and -wa (done to the thing).

example.question: Hadithi ___ na watoto wote.

misconceptions.cause: The endings look alike and the child does not ask what the verb says.
misconceptions.reveals: Sentences that need -wa or -ia in turn.
misconceptions.help: Ask: for someone, or done to the thing?
misconceptions.feedback: Kutendea (-ia, -ea) ni "kwa ajili ya mtu". Kutendwa (-wa) ni "kinatendwa na mtu".
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses na wrongly or leaves out "na" before the doer in the passive (Barua imeandikwa mwalimu).

example.question: Jaza: Barua imeandikwa ___ mwalimu.

misconceptions.cause: In English the doer follows "by", which the child links to kwa.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Barua imeandikwa ___ mwalimu." with "kwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The doer of a -wa verb is introduced with na: imeandikwa na mwalimu.
misconceptions.feedback: Mtendaji wa kitenzi chenye -wa hutajwa kwa "na".
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kushirikiana na wenzake kutaja miktadha ya mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi (k.v wanapocheza, wanapozungumza na marafiki, wakiwa nyumbani, n.k),
kutambua mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi kwa kutazama maigizo ya mazungumzo lengwa kwenye video na tarakilishi,

kutambua umuhimu wa nidhamu ya lugha katika mazingira yasiyo rasmi (k.m kutumia lugha ya upole, heshima na kumpa mwenzake nafasi ya kuzungumza na kusikiliza kwa makini anaposhiriki katika mazungumzo),
kuigiza mazungumzo katika miktadha isiyo rasmi (k.m akicheza na wenzake, akizungumza na wazazi, ndugu, nyanya au babu nyumbani) akiwa na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni lini tunatumia lugha isiyo rasmi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutaja miktadha ya mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza mazungumzo yaliyorekodiwa kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali ili kukuza msamiati wa lugha.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuigiza mazungumzo katika miktadha mbalimbali.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kusikiliza na kutazama mazungumzo.
sub_strands.values: Haki za kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake wa jamii mbalimbali na kuheshimu mchango wao katika mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi.
sub_strands.pcis: Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuigiza mazungumzo yanayolenga masuala makuu ya lishe bora na mazingira.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya mazungumzo katika miktadha mbalimbali katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la afya bora na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Agriculture.

outcomes.text: kutambua miktadha ya mawasiliano isiyo rasmi
kutumia lugha ipasavyo katika miktadha isiyo rasmi
kuchangamkia matumizi ya lugha katika miktadha isiyo rasmi

skills.name: Tambua miktadha isiyo rasmi na lugha yake
skills.mastery: Tells an informal setting (with a friend, at play, at home) from a formal one (a speech, an interview, a meeting) and picks the words that fit it, in 8 of 10 new items. Using them aloud is a teacher's check.

prerequisites.reason: Greetings change with the setting, which is the first lesson of context.
Following what a conversation is about comes first.

misconceptions.error: Takes a formal setting for an informal one.

example.question: Ni mazungumzo yapi si rasmi?
example.wrong_answer: hotuba ya mwalimu mkuu kwenye gwaride

misconceptions.cause: The child does not ask who is talking to whom.
misconceptions.reveals: A speech or an interview among settings with a friend.
misconceptions.help: Who is speaking to whom, and where?
misconceptions.feedback: Mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi ni ya marafiki, nyumbani au wakati wa kucheza. Hotuba na mahojiano ni rasmi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses words of the wrong kind of setting (a speech greeting to a friend at play).

example.question: Unamsalimia rafiki yako uwanjani. Utasema ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child has one way of speaking for every place.
misconceptions.reveals: A formal greeting for a friend.
misconceptions.help: Would you say it to a friend at play?
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa rafiki tunatumia lugha ya kawaida, kama "Mambo vipi?". Hotuba hutumia lugha rasmi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses Sheng or street words to an elder at home (Mambo vipi, mzee?).

example.question: Unamsalimu babu yako nyumbani. Unasema?

misconceptions.cause: The informal talk of friends is the informal talk the child knows; he does not see that home with elders needs respect even when it is not official.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unamsalimu babu yako nyumbani. Unasema?" with "Mambo vipi, mzee?" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort sentences into three settings: with friends, with family elders, in official places.
misconceptions.feedback: Hata nyumbani, mzee husalimiwa kwa heshima: Shikamoo babu.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Talks over others and does not wait for a turn in an informal chat.

example.question: Wenzako wanazungumza kuhusu mchezo. Unataka kusema jambo. Ufanye nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks informal means no rules.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wenzako wanazungumza kuhusu mchezo. Unataka kusema jambo. Ufanye nini?" with "zungumza kwa sauti juu yao" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pass a talking object in a small group; only the holder speaks.
misconceptions.feedback: Hata mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi yana adabu: subiri zamu yako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua matini (k.v vitabu, majarida, magazeti) zinazomvutia maktabani au mtandaoni,
kusoma matini aliyochagua (akizingatia suala lengwa) ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa,
kuwasimulia wenzake kuhusu matini aliyosoma ili kupashana ujumbe na kuchocheana kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha,
kujadiliana na wenzake matini ambayo wamesoma.
key_inquiry_questions: Kusoma matini mbalimbali kuna umuhimu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposimulia na kujadiliana na wenzake matini aliyoisoma ili kupashana ujumbe na kuchocheana kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kujifurahisha.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kupata matini ya kusoma.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojichagulia matini na kusoma kwa mapana.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza matini anayosoma pamoja na nyenzo zingine.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuhusu matini aliyosoma ili kujifurahisha na kupanua mawazo yake.
sub_strands.pcis: Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anaposoma matini yanayojumuisha mada ya afya bora ili kufaidi ujumbe uliotumiwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa mapana katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la afya bora na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Agriculture

outcomes.text: kutambua matini za kusoma za aina mbalimbali na kuchagua zinazomvutia
kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa
kufurahia usomaji wa aina mbalimbali za matini ili kupanua mawazo yake

skills.name: Chagua matini ya kusoma na ueleze ujumbe wake
skills.mastery: Chooses a text that suits his reading level and interest from its title, blurb and first page (not from the cover alone), tells the kind of text (hadithi, shairi, makala, gazeti), says its message in one sentence, and works out a new word from the sentence around it, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Choosing a text by its title and first page was learnt in Theme 7.
Finding the message of an article helps with any chosen text.

misconceptions.error: Chooses a book by its cover picture or its thickness only.

example.question: Unataka kusoma kuhusu afya bora. Utachaguaje kitabu?
example.correct_answer: kwa kusoma anwani, maelezo ya nyuma na ukurasa wa kwanza

misconceptions.cause: Nobody has shown the child the title, the blurb and the first page as clues.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unataka kusoma kuhusu afya bora. Utachaguaje kitabu?" with "kwa picha nzuri ya jalada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Hold up two books; read the title and the back of each aloud; the child chooses and says which clue decided it.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Chooses a text far above his reading level and gives up after a page.

example.question: Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Siri ya Afya ya Baraka" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: chagua matini nyingine iliyo ya kiwango chako

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks a harder book is a better book, or chooses the book a friend chose.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukisoma ukurasa wa kwanza wa "Siri ya Afya ya Baraka" na hujui maneno mengi sana, ufanye nini?" with "endelea tu hata kama huelewi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The five-finger check: on one page, a finger for each unknown word; five fingers means the book is too hard for now.
misconceptions.feedback: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the title as the message of the text.

example.question: Ujumbe wa matini "Siri ya Afya ya Baraka" ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Usafi, chakula bora na mazoezi hutupa afya njema.

misconceptions.cause: The title is the only sentence about the whole text that the child is sure of.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa matini "Siri ya Afya ya Baraka" ni upi?" with "Siri ya Afya ya Baraka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the writer wants the reader to learn or do; the title only names the topic.
misconceptions.feedback: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the text as its message.

example.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu afya bora?
example.correct_answer: Usafi, chakula bora na mazoezi hutupa afya njema.

misconceptions.cause: The detail was striking and is remembered; the child has not asked what the whole text is about.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu afya bora?" with "Baraka alikunywa maji glasi nane." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two boxes: "ujumbe" (one) and "maelezo" (many); the child sorts sentences from the text.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not tell one kind of text from another (takes a newspaper report for a story, or a poem for a story).

example.question: Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child has met most texts as "kitabu" and has not been shown the signs of each kind.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Matini yenye beti na mishororo ni ya aina gani?" with "hadithi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Lay out a story, a poem, a newspaper page and a dictionary; the child names one sign of each.
misconceptions.feedback: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Guesses a new word from how it looks, not from the sentence it is in (lishe).

example.question: Katika matini: "Mama alisema lishe bora ina mboga, matunda na nafaka." Neno "lishe" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a word it looks like instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika matini: "Mama alisema lishe bora ina mboga, matunda na nafaka." Neno "lishe" lina maana gani?" with "kulisha mifugo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child reads the sentence and says what word would fit; then compares.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma sentensi nzima: "lishe" hapa ni chakula anachokula mtu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua vifungu vya maelezo vilivyoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,
kuandika insha ya maelezo akitumia lugha ifaayo kutoa picha dhahiri kuhusu anachokieleza,

kuandika insha ya maelezo akizingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na lugha ya kiubunifu inayojumuisha methali na nahau alizojifunza awali,
kushiriki na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha (ihusiane na mada ya afya bora) na muundo wa insha ya maelezo,
kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali na kuisambaza mtandaoni kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waisikilize na kuitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni vitu gani vinavyoweza kutungiwa insha ya maelezo?
Ni mambo gani unayostahili kuzingatia unapoandika insha ya maelezo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapowasambazia wenzake insha ya maelezo aliyoiandika ili waisome na kuitathmini.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya maelezo.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya maelezo kwa kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu mada ya insha inayohusu afya bora na muundo wake katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kufanikisha kazi yake na kusambazia wenzake mtandaoni.
sub_strands.pcis: Umoja wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka maeneo mbalimbali katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika insha ya maelezo katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la afya bora na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Agriculture

outcomes.text: kutambua insha ya maelezo katika matini
kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
kuchangamkia utunzi wa insha ya maelezo ili kujenga ubunifu wake

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya maelezo
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya maelezo from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes an explanation or description on the topic, in order, with detail that makes a picture and no point off the topic; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Telling the kinds of insha and their parts comes before writing one.
Theme 7 wrote steps of a task in order.

misconceptions.error: Tells a story of what happened where the insha should explain or describe.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, lowesha mikono kwa maji safi yanayotiririka.

misconceptions.cause: Stories are the kind of writing the child has done most and he falls back on it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono"?" with "Siku moja tulienda sokoni tukapotea." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask what the reader should know about the topic at the end: what it is, how it works or is done.
misconceptions.feedback: Insha ya maelezo hueleza jambo lilivyo au jinsi linavyofanywa, si matukio ya siku moja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Describes with empty words (kizuri sana, kibaya) and no detail that makes a picture.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono"?
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, lowesha mikono kwa maji safi yanayotiririka.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the thing well and assumes the reader sees it too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inajenga picha dhahiri kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono"?" with "Usafi ni muhimu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Five senses chart: what do you see, hear, smell, touch, taste? Turn one row into a sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the steps of how to do something in a mixed-up order.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono"?
example.wrong_answer: suuza na kukausha, sugua kwa sekunde ishirini, paka sabuni, lowesha mikono
example.correct_answer: lowesha mikono, paka sabuni, sugua kwa sekunde ishirini, suuza na kukausha

misconceptions.cause: The child remembers the steps as a set, not as a sequence.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi unafaa katika maelezo ya "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono"?" with "suuza na kukausha, sugua kwa sekunde ishirini, paka sabuni, lowesha mikono" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out the steps; number them; write them with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
misconceptions.feedback: Maelezo ya jinsi ya kufanya jambo hufuata hatua kwa mpangilio.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts in points that are not about the title.

example.question: Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono", ni sentensi ipi haifai?
example.wrong_answer: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
example.correct_answer: Kwanza, lowesha mikono kwa maji safi yanayotiririka.

misconceptions.cause: The child adds whatever he remembers so the insha is long enough.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Katika insha ya maelezo yenye anwani "Jinsi ya Kunawa Mikono", ni sentensi ipi haifai?" with "Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read each sentence and ask: does it tell the reader about the title? Cross out the ones that do not.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kueleza maana ya kinyume cha nomino akishirikiana na wenzake,

kutambua vinyume vya nomino (k.v rafiki – adui, mgeni – mwenyeji, furaha – huzuni, mfalme- malkia, usiku – mchana, tajiri – maskini, n.k) katika chati, kadi maneno, kapu maneno, mti maneno au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kushirikiana na wenzake kutafuta vinyume vya nomino kwa kurejelea orodha ya nomino alizopewa,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya nomino,
kutunga sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya nomino kwa kuzingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi.
key_inquiry_questions: Matumizi ya vinyume vya nomino huchangia vipi katika ukuzaji wa lugha?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake darasani kutafuta vinyume vya nomino.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kwa kutumia vinyume vya nomino ipasavyo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutambua vinyume vya nomino.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotafuta vinyume vya nomino akirejelea orodha aliyopea ipasavyo.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza kifaa cha kidijitali na nyenzo zingine anazotumia katika kufanikisha kazi yake.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli ya kikundi na kuthamini maoni yao.
sub_strands.pcis: Elimu ya mazingira: mwanafunzi anapotalii mazingira yake na kuunda orodha ya vinyume anavyoweza kutambua.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya vinyume katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la afya bora na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Agriculture

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya kinyume cha nomino ili kukibainisha
kutambua vinyume vya nomino katika matini
kutumia vinyume vya nomino ipasavyo katika matini
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vinyume vya nomino katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tambua na tumia vinyume vya nomino
skills.mastery: Gives the true opposite of a noun (usiku-mchana, rafiki-adui, furaha-huzuni, tajiri-maskini) and does not choose a related word or a word of the same meaning, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Picks a related word, not the opposite (usiku-jioni, rafiki-ndugu).

example.question: Kinyume cha "usiku" ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child picks a word of the same family of ideas.
misconceptions.reveals: A related word as an option.
misconceptions.help: Is it the opposite, or only near it?
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume ni neno lenye maana kinyume kabisa: usiku-mchana. "Jioni" iko karibu na usiku lakini si kinyume.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word of the same meaning (furaha-raha).

example.question: Kinyume cha "furaha" ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes the opposite with the synonym.
misconceptions.reveals: A synonym as an option.
misconceptions.help: Same meaning or opposite?
misconceptions.feedback: "Raha" ina maana sawa na furaha. Kinyume cha furaha ni huzuni.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the other word of a pair in the wrong place (mgeni-rafiki for mgeni-mwenyeji).

example.question: Kinyume cha "mgeni" ni ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child takes a word that goes with the idea.
misconceptions.reveals: A word that goes with the noun but is not its opposite.
misconceptions.help: Who is the visitor and who receives him?
misconceptions.feedback: Mgeni ni anayetembelea, na mwenyeji ni anayepokea. Ni vinyume.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Makes the opposite by adding si or "si-" to the noun (si-rafiki, si urefu).

example.question: Kinyume cha "rafiki" ni kipi?

misconceptions.cause: Making verbs negative with si- is known; the child uses it for nouns too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "rafiki" ni kipi?" with "sirafiki" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A noun's opposite is another noun; list pairs: rafiki/adui, mchana/usiku, mwanzo/mwisho.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha nomino ni nomino nyingine: rafiki, adui.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kushirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya tashbihi,
kutambua tashbihi za kimo na umbo (k.v mrefu kama twiga, mfupi kama nyundo, mwembamba kama sindano, konda kama ng’onda) katika vitabu, chati na vyombo vya kidijitali,
kurejelea picha au michoro kwenye chati au tarakilishi ili kutumia tashbihi zifaazo kutolea maelezo,
kujaza nafasi katika sentensi au kifungu kwa kutumia tashbihi za kimo na umbo,
kutunga sentensi akitumia tashbihi za kimo na umbo,
kuwasilisha sentensi zake darasani ili wenzake wazitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Matumizi ya tashbihi yana umuhimu gani katika mawasiliano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kazi ya vikundi kueleza maana ya tashbihi za kimo na umbo.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapojaribu kukamilisha kazi ya ziada anayopewa kuhusu tashbihi za kimo na umbo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika kujifunza tashbihi za kimo na umbo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake na kuelezea maana za tashbihi mbalimbali.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutunga sentensi akirejelea picha na michoro kwenye tarakilishi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya mazingira: mwanafunzi anarejelea mifano ya vitu na viumbe katika mazingira yake.
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka maeneo mbalimbali kuelezea maana ya tashbihi za umbo na kimo.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya tashbihi katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kukabiliana na uhalifu na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya tashbihi ili kuibainisha
kutambua tashbihi za kimo na umbo katika matini
kutumia tashbihi za kimo na umbo kwa usahihi katika matini
kufurahia matumizi ya tashbihi za kimo na umbo katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na tumia tashbihi za kimo na umbo
skills.mastery: Gives the usual comparison for height, size and shape (mrefu kama twiga, mnene kama kiboko, mkubwa kama ndovu) and says it is a simile because of kama, without taking it word for word, in 8 of 10 new items. Using it aloud is a teacher's check.

prerequisites.reason: A simile compares a quality (mrefu, mfupi), which is a describing word.
The child has met words that do not mean what they say.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Gives the wrong animal or thing in the simile (mrefu kama sungura).

example.question: Mtu mrefu sana ni mrefu kama ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the idea but not the usual comparison.
misconceptions.reveals: A simile with plausible animals as options.
misconceptions.help: Which animal do we say is tall?
misconceptions.feedback: Tashbihi hutumia ulinganisho wa kawaida: mrefu kama twiga, mnene kama kiboko, mkubwa kama ndovu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out kama, and says "Yeye ni twiga" as a simile.

example.question: Ni tashbihi ipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes a simile with a metaphor.
misconceptions.reveals: A simile and a metaphor as options.
misconceptions.help: A simile has the word kama.
misconceptions.feedback: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kutumia kama: mrefu kama twiga. "Yeye ni twiga" ni sitiari.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the simile word for word (the person is really a giraffe).

example.question: "Baba ni mrefu kama twiga" maana yake nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not read the comparison as a way to describe.
misconceptions.reveals: A meaning question for a simile.
misconceptions.help: What is the animal used to show?
misconceptions.feedback: Tashbihi inaelezea kwa kulinganisha. "Mrefu kama twiga" ina maana mtu ni mrefu sana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Joins the right animal to the wrong quality (mfupi kama twiga).

example.question: Kamilisha tashbihi: mrefu kama ___

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the animals of similes but not which quality each stands for.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kamilisha tashbihi: mrefu kama ___" with "nyoka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a chart: twiga - urefu, nyoka - wembamba?, tembo - unene; test each simile against the chart.
misconceptions.feedback: Twiga ni mrefu, kwa hiyo tunasema mrefu kama twiga.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama kutoka kwenye chati au kwenye tarakilishi na mitandao,
kutambua jina la faili lengwa kwenye tarakilishi na kufanya mazoezi ya kuifungua na kuifunga,
kutambua mitandao salama yenye matini yanayoafiki kiwango na mahitaji yake,
kutambua umuhimu wa kutoa habari kwa mwalimu, mzazi au mlezi wake endapo atapata ujumbe kutoka kwa watu asiowajua mtandaoni na kutowasiliana nao,
kutafuta maana za maneno mapya kwenye kamusi mtandaoni,
kusoma matini kwenye tovuti salama,
kusikiliza matamshi na maelezo kuhusu anachokisoma mtandaoni panapowezekana,
kutoa habari kuhusu matini aliyosoma kwa muhtasari na kujibu maswali katika maandishi au mazungumzo na wenzake.
