Kusoma matini ya kidijitali kuna umuhimu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali katika kutafuta, kusakura na kusoma matini.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapopata hamu ya kutafuta matini ya kusoma kwenye tarakilishi na mitandaoni.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapokitunza kifaa cha kidijitali na kuzingatia mitandao salama.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kutoa habari kwa muhtasari kuhusu matini aliyoisoma ili waiboreshe.
sub_strands.pcis:
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapozingatia hatua za kiusalama anaposakura matini kwenye tovuti.
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka jamii tofauti tofauti kufanya shughuli ya kikundi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la Science and Technology.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kukabiliana na uhalifu na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua na kuzingatia hatua za kiusalama katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali
kutambua na kufungua faili iliyo na kifungu cha kusoma ili kuimarisha umilisi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi
kusakura matini kwenye tovuti salama ili kupata vifungu vya kusoma vyenye suala lengwa
kusoma matini lengwa ili kupata ujumbe
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika kutafuta na kusoma ujumbe ili kuimarisha maarifa yake

skills.name: Fungua faili, sakura kwenye tovuti salama na usome matini ya kidijitali
skills.mastery: Opens a saved file with the passage (finds the folder, double-clicks the file), searches a safe site with two or three key words, ignores pop-ups and adverts, and reads the passage for its message, in 8 of 10 new items or tasks.

prerequisites.reason: Opening files and searching safely were first done in Theme 4.
Safety steps on a digital device come first.

misconceptions.error: Mixes up a folder and a file: looks for the passage on the screen without opening the folder it is in.

example.question: Kifungu "Usalama wetu" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?
example.wrong_answer: bonyeza "Usalama wetu" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo
example.correct_answer: fungua folda "Kiswahili", kisha bonyeza mara mbili faili "Usalama wetu"

misconceptions.cause: The child has only used apps on a phone, where there are no folders.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kifungu "Usalama wetu" kimehifadhiwa ndani ya folda "Kiswahili". Utakifunguaje?" with "bonyeza "Usalama wetu" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show a real folder (a box file) holding papers; then the same on the screen.
misconceptions.feedback: Faili huhifadhiwa ndani ya folda; fungua folda kwanza, kisha faili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Types a whole long question, with spelling mistakes, into the search box.

example.question: Unatafuta habari kuhusu kukabiliana na uhalifu. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?
example.wrong_answer: naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu kukabiliana na uhalifu tafadhali

misconceptions.cause: The child talks to the search box as to a person.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unatafuta habari kuhusu kukabiliana na uhalifu. Utaandika nini kwenye kisanduku cha kutafutia?" with "naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu kukabiliana na uhalifu tafadhali" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the two or three words that carry the meaning; search with those; compare the results.
misconceptions.feedback: Andika maneno mawili au matatu muhimu tu, na uyaandike kwa tahajia sahihi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Clicks a pop-up or an advert that says he has won a prize.

example.question: Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usibonyeze; funga ujumbe na umwambie mwalimu au mzazi

misconceptions.cause: Offers of prizes are exciting and the child does not know they are traps.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ukiwa unasoma, ujumbe unatokea: "Umeshinda simu! Bonyeza hapa." Ufanye nini?" with "bonyeza ili kupokea simu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show two screenshots, one real page and one trap; the child finds three signs of the trap.
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe wa zawadi usiotarajiwa ni mtego; usiubonyeze.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses any site that comes up and gives his name, school or phone number when a site asks.

example.question: Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?
example.correct_answer: usijaze; tumia tovuti salama aliyokupa mwalimu

misconceptions.cause: The child wants the story and does not see personal details as worth protecting.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tovuti inakuuliza jina lako kamili, shule yako na nambari ya simu ya mzazi kabla ya kusoma hadithi. Ufanye nini?" with "jaza ili usome hadithi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: List the details that are private; practise saying no to a form.
misconceptions.feedback: Usimpe mtu yeyote mtandaoni jina lako kamili, shule yako wala nambari ya simu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the steps of finding and reading a passage in the wrong order (reads before searching, or searches before switching on).

example.question: Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?

misconceptions.cause: The child has watched an adult do the steps quickly and remembers the parts, not the order.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni hatua ipi huja kwanza?" with "andika maneno ya kutafutia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Step cards: the child orders them, then does them on a real device.
misconceptions.feedback: Washa kifaa, fungua kivinjari, andika maneno muhimu, chagua tovuti salama, soma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Insha ya Masimulizi (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na uhalifu)
learning_experiences: kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya insha zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,
kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili mada ya insha na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi,

kuandika insha inayosimulia kisa cha tukio linalohusiana na uhalifu wa kawaida daftarini kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,
kuandika insha ya masimulizi mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini,
kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika ili waitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unazingatia nini ili kuandika insha nzuri ya masimulizi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi ya kikundi kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni kwa kurejelea kielelezo cha insha ya masimulizi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi na kuthamini mchango wao.
Amani: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuwasomea wenzake insha aliyoandika kwa upendo.
sub_strands.pcis:
Kukabiliana na uhalifu: mwanafunzi anapoandika kisa cha tukio linalohusiana na uhalifu wa kawaida.
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili mada na muundo wa insha ya masimulizi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya uandishi wa insha ya masimulizi katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kukabiliana na uhalifu na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua insha ya masimulizi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, mtindo na muundo
kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
kuchangamkia utunzi mzuri wa insha ya masimulizi ili kujenga ubunifu wake

skills.name: Tambua na andika insha ya masimulizi
skills.mastery: Tells insha ya masimulizi from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a story of events in the past tense, in order, with a title, an opening, a middle and a closing that gives the lesson; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Telling the kinds of insha and their parts comes before writing one.
Theme 8 wrote a story in order with a closing.

misconceptions.error: Writes facts or an explanation where a story of events is asked.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?
example.wrong_answer: Wizi ni kosa kubwa katika jamii.
example.correct_answer: Mwizi alinyakua mkoba wa mama mmoja akakimbia.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows a lot about the topic and writes what he knows instead of telling what happened.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi ni mwanzo wa insha ya masimulizi yenye anwani "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?" with "Wizi ni kosa kubwa katika jamii." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask: who, where, what happened first, then, in the end? A story answers these; an explanation does not.
misconceptions.feedback: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells a past story in the present tense (-na-), or mixes -na- and -li- in one story.

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?
example.wrong_answer: Mwizi ananyakua mkoba wa mama mmoja anakimbia.
example.correct_answer: Mwizi alinyakua mkoba wa mama mmoja akakimbia.

misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he speaks while remembering, and English stories in class are told in the present too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika masimulizi ya jambo lililotokea jana: "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?" with "Mwizi ananyakua mkoba wa mama mmoja anakimbia." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Circle every verb; check its tense marker against the time words (jana, siku moja).
misconceptions.feedback: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the events in an order that cannot have happened (the end before the start), with no linking words.

example.question: Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?
example.wrong_answer: mama alirudishiwa mkoba, polisi walimkamata, watu walipiga kelele, mwizi alinyakua mkoba
example.correct_answer: mwizi alinyakua mkoba, watu walipiga kelele, polisi walimkamata, mama alirudishiwa mkoba

misconceptions.cause: The child writes events as they come to mind; nobody has asked for a plan first.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni mpangilio upi wa matukio unafaa katika insha "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?" with "mama alirudishiwa mkoba, polisi walimkamata, watu walipiga kelele, mwizi alinyakua mkoba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Plan with three boxes (mwanzo, kati, mwisho) and linking words (kwanza, kisha, hatimaye) before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends the insha abruptly ("Mwisho." or "The end") with no closing paragraph (hitimisho).

example.question: Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?
example.correct_answer: Tangu siku hiyo, nimejifunza kuwa mwangalifu kila wakati.

misconceptions.cause: Storybooks for young readers end with "Mwisho" and the child copies that.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni ipi ni hitimisho bora la insha "Mwizi Aliyekamatwa Sokoni"?" with "Mwisho." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show three endings; the child picks the one that closes the main idea or the lesson.
misconceptions.feedback: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Nyakati na hali. (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na uhalifu)
learning_experiences: kutambua viambishi vinavyobainisha nyakati mbalimbali (uliopita, uliopo na ujao) kwenye sentensi zilizoonyeshwa kwenye chati, ubao au kwa kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali k.v. tarakilishi na projekta,
kujaza nafasi kwenye sentensi kwa kutumia vitenzi katika nyakati mbalimbali,
kutambua vitenzi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao kwenye matini akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutunga sentensi akitumia vitenzi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao kwa kuziandika daftarini au kuzipiga chapa kwenye tarakilishi/ kipakatalishi,
kushirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi kutaja sentensi katika wakati fulani na kuzibadilisha katika wakati tofauti,
kuandika upya sentensi kutoka wakati mmoja ziwe katika nyakati tofauti daftarini au katika kifaa cha kidijitali,
key_inquiry_questions: Ni viambishi vipi hutumika kuwakilisha nyakati mbalimbali katika vitenzi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za vikundi darasani na mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia nyakati mbalimbali.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutunga sentensi sahihi katika nyakati mbalimbali hali ya kuendelea.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kipakatalishi au tarakilishi kutunga sentensi na vilevile kuzisambaza mtandaoni.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapojifunza kuthamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli ya kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali na nyenzo zingine kufanikisha kazi yake.
sub_strands.pcis:
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kubainisha nyakati mbalimbali.
Kupambana na ufundishaji wa misimamo mikali: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya nyakati katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la kukabiliana na uhalifu na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies.

outcomes.text: kutambua viambishi vya wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao kwenye vitenzi
kutambua vitenzi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao kwenye matini
kutunga sentensi akitumia vitenzi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao
kufurahia zoezi la kutunga sentensi akiwa na wenzake

skills.name: Tambua na tumia nyakati: -li-, -na- na -ta-
skills.mastery: Uses -li- for what happened before (jana alisoma), -na- for now (anasoma) and -ta- for what will happen (atasoma), following the time word, and gives the right person prefix, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
The person prefix a- / wa- is met in the third-person sentences of Grade 3.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Uses -na- for every time, whatever the time word.

example.question: Jana, Juma a___soma kitabu.

misconceptions.cause: The child has fixed -na- as the way to make a verb.
misconceptions.reveals: Time words (jana, kesho) next to -na-.
misconceptions.help: Read the time word first: jana, now, or kesho?
misconceptions.feedback: Wakati uliopita unatumia -li-: jana alisoma. Uliopo -na-: sasa anasoma. Ujao -ta-: kesho atasoma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Swaps -li- and -ta- (kesho alisoma).

example.question: Kesho, Wanjiru a___soma kitabu.

misconceptions.cause: The child knows the markers but not which time each is for.
misconceptions.reveals: Past and future time words in turn.
misconceptions.help: Has it happened, or will it happen?
misconceptions.feedback: -li- ni kwa yaliyotokea. -ta- ni kwa yatakayotokea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Keeps the tense right and changes the person prefix (wanasoma for tunasoma).

example.question: Chagua kitenzi: Jana sisi ___ kwa basi.

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the tense and not at the person.
misconceptions.reveals: The same verb with different persons.
misconceptions.help: Who is it? Sisi is tu-.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitenzi kinahitaji nafsi na wakati: sisi tulisafiri, wao walisafiri, mimi nilisafiri.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ignores the time word in the sentence (jana, kesho, sasa) and keeps the tense of the sentence before.

example.question: Jaza: Kesho Juma ___ (enda) Nairobi.

misconceptions.cause: The child copies the tense of the last verb he wrote.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kesho Juma ___ (enda) Nairobi." with "alienda" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the time word first; it decides the marker: jana -li-, sasa -na-, kesho -ta-.
misconceptions.feedback: Kesho ni wakati ujao: -ta-. Atakwenda.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kusikiliza masimulizi yanayohusiana na suala lengwa yakitolewa na mgeni mwalikwa, mwalimu, mwanafunzi mwenzake au kutokana na vifaa vya kidijitali,
kujibu maswali kutokana na masimulizi aliyosikiliza,
kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa uliotumiwa katika masimulizi aliyosikiliza,
kubuni simulizi linalohusiana na mada husika kwa kutazama picha, michoro au kujadiliana na wenzake,
kutoa maelezo kuhusu suala lengwa (k.v jinsi ya kujipatia riziki, Jinsi ya kutumia mapato yake, n.k.),
kutumia ishara za mwili zifaazo k.v ishara za uso, za mikono, mabega kuimarisha masimulizi yake,
kujadiliana na wenzake kuhusu ubora wa masimulizi aliyosikiliza.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni nini unachozingatia unapotoa simulizi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu ubora wa masimulizi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga simulizi linalohusiana na mada husika kwa kutazama picha au michoro.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anaposimulia kisa mbele ya wenzake.
sub_strands.values: Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu mchango wa wenzake katika mjadala kuhusu ubora wa masimulizi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya fedha: mwanafunzi anaposimulia kisa kuhusu ujuzi wa matumizi ya fedha na mapato.
Umaskini: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza na kuzungumzia kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusikiliza na kutoa masimulizi katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la mapato na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies, Creative Arts na Science and Technology.

outcomes.text: kusikiliza masimulizi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe
kusimulia tungo kwa kuzingatia mada, ubunifu na usanifu wa lugha mbele ya wenzake
kutumia ishara zifaazo ili kuimarisha masimulizi yake
kuchangamkia masimulizi katika mazingira mbalimbali

skills.name: Sikiliza masimulizi kwa ujumbe na usimulie kwa ishara zifaazo
skills.mastery: Listens to a short narration and gives its message (not a detail), retells it in order, and tells his own story on the topic in Kiswahili sanifu with gestures that match the words; the teacher scores the telling with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the message, order or gesture in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Finding the message and the order of events in a read story is the same work as in a heard one.
Grade 3 listening for the message of a short passage comes first.

misconceptions.error: Gives a detail of the narration as its message.

example.question: Ulisikiliza masimulizi kuhusu mama aliyeuza mboga sokoni na kuweka akiba. Ujumbe wake ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukiweka akiba kidogo kidogo, tunaweza kutimiza mahitaji yetu.

misconceptions.cause: The detail was vivid; the child has not asked what the whole narration teaches.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ulisikiliza masimulizi kuhusu mama aliyeuza mboga sokoni na kuweka akiba. Ujumbe wake ni upi?" with "Mama aliuza sukumawiki sokoni." among the options.
misconceptions.help: After listening, ask: what did the speaker want us to learn? Then: what is one thing that happened?
misconceptions.feedback: Ujumbe ni funzo la masimulizi yote; jambo moja ni maelezo tu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Retells the events in a mixed order, starting with the most exciting part.

example.question: Unaposimulia, unaanza na nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child jumps to the part that impressed him most.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unaposimulia, unaanza na nini?" with "sehemu ya kusisimua zaidi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Retell with three fingers: mwanzo, kati, mwisho.
misconceptions.feedback: Simulia kwa mpangilio: mwanzo, kati, mwisho.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses gestures or a face that do not match the words (smiles while telling a sad part, stands still for an action).

example.question: Unasimulia: "Tulifurahi sana tulipopata faida!" Ishara ipi inafaa?

misconceptions.cause: The child is nervous and does not link the body to the words.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasimulia: "Tulifurahi sana tulipopata faida!" Ishara ipi inafaa?" with "kukunja uso na kuinamisha kichwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Mirror game in pairs: one says a line, the other shows the feeling; swap.
misconceptions.feedback: Ishara na sura yako ziendane na unachosema.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes English or Sheng into the telling (Then tukaenda..., ilikuwa poa sana).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa unaposimulia darasani?
example.wrong_answer: Then tukaenda home, ilikuwa poa sana.
example.correct_answer: Kisha tukaenda nyumbani; ilikuwa siku nzuri sana.

misconceptions.cause: The child narrates as he talks with friends.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inafaa unaposimulia darasani?" with "Then tukaenda home, ilikuwa poa sana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Record a telling; play it back; the child finds the non-Kiswahili words and replaces them.
misconceptions.feedback: Simulia kwa Kiswahili sanifu: kisha, nyumbani, nzuri.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Tells a story that is not on the topic given (mapato (income)).

example.question: Mada ni mapato (income). Ni masimulizi yapi yanafaa?
example.correct_answer: Siku mama aliyeuza mboga sokoni na kuweka akiba

misconceptions.cause: The child tells the story he knows best, whatever the topic.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mada ni mapato (income). Ni masimulizi yapi yanafaa?" with "Siku nilipotazama mechi ya mpira" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Write the topic on the board; before telling, the child says in one sentence how his story fits it.
misconceptions.feedback: Masimulizi yako yahusu mada uliyopewa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma makala kwa ufasaha,
kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti (k.v kiwango cha sauti na kiimbo),
kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno sahihi yasiyopungua 65 kwa dakika ) ili wenzake wamtolee maoni,
kusoma kifungu kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo panapofaa anaposoma (k.v ishara za uso na mikono),
kusoma hadithi kuhusu masuala mtambuko mbalimbali kutoka kwenye vitabu, vifaa vya kidijtali, n.k akizingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti.
key_inquiry_questions: Kusoma kwa ufasaha kuna umuhimu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kusoma kifungu cha hadithi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusoma vifungu cha hadithi kuhusu masuala mtambuko mbalimbali.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapotafuta hadithi mbalimbali na kuzisoma kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na kiwango kifaacho cha sauti.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowashirikisha wengine katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali.
sub_strands.pcis: Uraia: mwanafunzi anapowathamini wenzake wanaposhirikiana kutamka sauti lengwa katika kikundi.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa ufasaha katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la mapato na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies, Creative Arts na Science and Technology.

outcomes.text: kutambua vipengele vya kuzingatia katika kusoma kwa ufasaha
kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora
kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia kiwango kifaacho cha sauti
kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo
kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kwa kuambatanisha ishara zifaazo
kuchangamkia kusoma kwa ufasaha ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Soma kifungu kwa sauti kwa matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo, sauti ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Reads a short passage aloud at a speaking pace, pauses at the koma and the kikomo, raises the voice for a question and shows feeling for an exclamation, says every sound clearly (no l for r), and uses a matching gesture, judged by the teacher with the KICD rubric; in the app picks the better reading of a line in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Reading aloud fluently in Theme 3 comes before the longer passage of Theme 11.
The features of fluent reading are named first.

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Baba aliuza mahindi na kuweka pesa benki."?
example.wrong_answer: Baba ... aliuza ... mahindi ... na ... kuweka ... pesa ... benki.
example.correct_answer: Baba aliuza mahindi na kuweka pesa benki.

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word and has not yet learnt to read a phrase as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Baba aliuza mahindi na kuweka pesa benki."?" with "Baba ... aliuza ... mahindi ... na ... kuweka ... pesa ... benki." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it as one breath; then phrase-cut the passage with slashes.
misconceptions.feedback: Usomaji wa ufasaha husoma kundi la maneno kwa pamoja, kama tunavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, ili kila neno lisikike

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; the child has not been asked whether listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kasi ipi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu darasani?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings: one very fast, one at speaking pace; listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ile ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question and an exclamation in the same flat voice as a statement.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umeweka akiba yako wapi?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the mark at the end.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umeweka akiba yako wapi?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that matches each reading.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads on through the koma and the kikomo without a pause.

example.question: Unasoma: "Hongera, umepata faida kubwa!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?
example.wrong_answer: hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja
example.correct_answer: kwenye koma na kwenye kikomo au alama ya hisi

misconceptions.cause: The marks are read as decoration; the child has not linked them to breath.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasoma: "Hongera, umepata faida kubwa!" Unasimama wapi kidogo?" with "hapana mahali, unasoma moja kwa moja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap once at a koma, twice at a kikomo while reading together.
misconceptions.feedback: Simama kidogo kwenye koma, na zaidi kwenye kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /l/ for /r/ or /r/ for /l/ while reading (biashara read as biashala).

example.question: Neno "biashara" linatamkwa vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The first language of the child does not separate these sounds, so the reading carries the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "biashara" linatamkwa vipi?" with "biashala" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make a list of the passage words with the hard sound; practise them before reading the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamka "biashara" kama lilivyoandikwa; "biashala" ni neno jingine au si neno.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua barua ya kirafiki kwa kurejelea vielelezo vya barua za kirafiki zilizoandikwa kwenye matini mbalimbali au tarakilishi,
kuandaa vidokezo vitakavyomwongoza kuandika insha yake,
kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili mada ya barua ya kirafiki na vipengele vyake,

kuandika barua ya kirafiki daftarini yenye kuzingatia mada ya mapato kwa rafiki, ndugu, mzazi n.k kwa kuzingatia anwani, mpangilio mzuri wa mawazo, hati safi, tahajia, kanuni za kisarufi, uakifishaji mwafaka na kwa lugha ya kiubunifu,
kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha ya barua kuhusu kupigana na umaskini,
kuandika barua ya kirafiki mtandaoni na kuisambaza kwa wenzake na mwalimu ili waisome na kuitathmini,
kuwasomea wenzake barua ya kirafiki aliyoandika ili waitathmini,
kushirikiana na wenzake katika vikundi kujadili kuhusu umuhimu wa barua za kirafiki katika mawasiliano.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unazingatia nini ili kuandika barua nzuri ya kirafiki?
Barua za kirafiki zina umuhimu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mijadala na kazi ya kikundi kujadili mada ya barua ya kirafiki na vipengele vyake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika insha mtandaoni na kurejelea vielelezo vya barua za kirafiki.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoandaa vidokezo na kuandika barua za kirafiki kwa ubunifu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoyatafakari maswali dadisi na anapoimarisha ujuzi wake wa kutumia tarakilishi.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika mjadala na wenzake na kuthamini maoni yao.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika barua kuhusu kupigana na umaskini.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali kujadili mada ya barua ya kirafiki.
Umaskini: mwanafunzi anapoandika kuhusu jinsi ya kupigana na umaskini.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya uandishi wa barua ya kirafiki katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la mapato na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Social Studies, Creative Arts na Science and Technology.

outcomes.text: kutambua barua ya kirafiki kwa kuzingatia muundo
kuandika barua ya kirafiki kwa kuzingatia ujumbe, mtindo na muundo ufaao
kuchangamkia umuhimu wa barua katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Andika barua ya kirafiki kwa muundo na lugha ifaayo
skills.mastery: Tells barua ya kirafiki from other kinds of writing and its parts, and writes a friendly letter with the address, date, greeting, asking after the friend, the news, and a friendly closing; the teacher marks the writing with the KICD rubric, and in the app the child picks the right sentence, order or part in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: The first friendly letter was written in Theme 4.
The parts of the letter.

misconceptions.error: Writes to a friend in the stiff words of an official letter (Mheshimiwa, Kuhusu:, Wako mtiifu).

example.question: Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?

misconceptions.cause: The child has seen official letters at school and thinks every letter is written that way.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni salamu ipi inafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?" with "Mheshimiwa Bwana," among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put a friendly and an official letter side by side; the child highlights the words that differ.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki hutumia lugha ya kirafiki: Mpendwa rafiki, Wako akupendaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Starts with the news straight after the greeting, with no asking after the friend (maulizo ya hali).

example.question: Baada ya salamu, ni sentensi ipi inafuata katika barua ya kirafiki?
example.correct_answer: Hujambo? Natumai u buheri wa afya.

misconceptions.cause: The child goes to what he wants to say, as in a text message.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Baada ya salamu, ni sentensi ipi inafuata katika barua ya kirafiki?" with "Nataka kukueleza kuhusu safari yetu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Order the parts on cards: anwani, tarehe, salamu, maulizo ya hali, ujumbe, hitimisho, jina.
misconceptions.feedback: Baada ya salamu, uliza hali ya rafiki yako kabla ya kueleza ujumbe.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out the date or writes it in the middle of the letter.

example.question: Tarehe huandikwa wapi katika barua ya kirafiki?
example.correct_answer: chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, upande wa kulia juu

misconceptions.cause: The date is not part of what the child wants to say, so he forgets it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tarehe huandikwa wapi katika barua ya kirafiki?" with "mwishoni, baada ya jina" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Label a model letter; the child places a date card on a blank layout.
misconceptions.feedback: Tarehe huandikwa chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, juu upande wa kulia.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Ends with "Wako mtiifu" and a full name and title, as in an official letter.

example.question: Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?

misconceptions.cause: Again the official model is the only one the child has copied.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni hitimisho lipi linafaa katika barua kwa rafiki?" with "Wako mtiifu, Bw. Juma Hamisi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Collect three friendly closings and keep them in the exercise book.
misconceptions.feedback: Barua ya kirafiki humalizika kwa "Ni mimi rafiki yako," na jina la kwanza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kushirikiana na wenzake kueleza maana ya ukanushaji,
kutambua maneno yaliyokanushwa kwenye chati, ubao, kapu maneno, mti maneno na vyombo vya kidijitali,
kutambua viambishi vya nafsi na wakati katika maneno akishirikiana na wenzake,
kukanusha sentensi akizingatia nafsi na nyakati kwenye daftari au kwa kutumia tarakilishi,
kuwasilisha sentensi zake darasani ili wenzake wazitathmini.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini unapokanusha sentensi kwa kuzingatia nafsi na wakati?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili mada kwenye vikundi.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapojaribu kukanusha maneno na sentensi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kukanusha maneno na sentensi za nafsi na nyakati.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kazi za kikundi na kuthamini mchango wa wenzake.
Uadilifu: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza au kutazama vipindi vya ukanushaji katika vyombo vya kidijitali.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utunzi na usalama wa Watoto: mwanafunzi anapokuza uwezo wa kukubali au kukataa mambo mbalimbali kupitia kipindi cha ukanushaji wa nafsi.
Umaskini: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi mbalimbali kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya ukanushaji katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English.

outcomes.text: kueleza maana ya ukanushaji ili kuubainisha
kutambua maneno yaliyokanushwa katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao
kutambua viambishi vya nafsi na wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao katika maneno
kukanusha sentensi kwa kuzingatia nafsi na wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao
kuchangamkia ukanushaji wa vitenzi katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Kanusha sentensi kwa nafsi na wakati
skills.mastery: Makes the negative of a verb in the past (hakusoma), present (hasomi) and future (hatasoma) for the person, and tells a negative from a positive verb, without only adding ha- or keeping the tense marker, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Only adds ha- or si- and keeps the tense marker (hanasoma, sinasoma).

example.question: Kanusha: "Mimi ninasoma."

misconceptions.cause: The child does not know that the marker changes in the negative.
misconceptions.reveals: A negative made by only adding ha- or si-.
misconceptions.help: In the present negative, -na- goes and the verb ends in -i.
misconceptions.feedback: Kukanusha wakati uliopo: -na- huondolewa na kitenzi huishia -i: nasoma-sisomi, anasoma-hasomi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Keeps -li- or -ta- after ha- (halipika, hatapika for hakupika).

example.question: Kanusha: "Wanjiru alipika."

misconceptions.cause: The child puts ha- in front and leaves the rest.
misconceptions.reveals: A past verb with ha- put in front.
misconceptions.help: -li- becomes -ku- in the past negative.
misconceptions.feedback: Wakati uliopita ukikanushwa, -li- hubadilika kuwa -ku-: alipika-hakupika.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the negative of another time (hasomi for hakusoma).

example.question: Kanusha: "Wanafunzi wanaimba."

misconceptions.cause: The child negates the verb but does not keep the time.
misconceptions.reveals: Negatives of the three times side by side.
misconceptions.help: Which time was the first sentence in?
misconceptions.feedback: Ukanushaji huhifadhi wakati: uliopita hawakuimba, uliopo hawaimbi, ujao hawataimba.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes a positive verb for a negative one.

example.question: Ni neno lipi limekanushwa?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not look for the ha-, si-, hu- or ku-.
misconceptions.reveals: A negative and a positive verb together.
misconceptions.help: Which verb says that it did not, does not or will not happen?
misconceptions.feedback: Neno lililokanushwa linaonyesha kwamba kitendo hakifanyiki: hasomi, hakusoma, hatasoma.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua nomino zinazoanza kwa herufi m- na zenye mzizi wa silabi moja (k.m mti, mto, mji) kwenye chati, ubao, mti maneno, kapu maneno au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kushiriki katika vikundi kubadilisha nomino kutoka hali ya wastani hadi hali ya ukubwa,
kushiriki katika mchezo wa vikundi; kikundi kimoja kitaje wastani wa nomino na kingine kitaje ukubwa wa nomino hiyo,
kuburura na kuambatanisha orodha ya nomino katika hali ya ukubwa na orodha nyingine ya nomino katika hali ya wastani kwenye tarakilishi,
kutunga sentensi zinazorejelea nomino lengwa katika ukubwa akiwa peke yake au kwenye vikundi.
key_inquiry_questions: Kutaja nomino katika ukubwa wake kuna umuhimu gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki mijadala kuhusu ukubwa wa nomino.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi katika hali ya ukubwa ipasavyo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia tarakilishi kutambua na kuambatanisha nomino katika hali ya wastani na ukubwa.
sub_strands.values:
Ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Haki za kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali katika kutunga sentensi zinazohusu nomino lengwa.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utangamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapokuza uraia wema kwa kutangamana na wenzake kutoka maeneo tofautitofauti.
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutambua ukubwa wa nomino.

skills.name: Badilisha nomino za m- kuwa katika hali ya ukubwa
skills.mastery: Gives the big form (ji-) of the m- nouns with a one-syllable root (mti-jiti, mto-jito, mji-jiji, mtu-jitu) for one and for many (majiti), and does not keep the noun, use ki-, or give one for many, in 8 of 10 new items.

prerequisites.reason: Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Proposed: this skill builds on it. To confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

leads_to.reason: Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.
Grade 5 builds on this skill. Proposed, to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher.

misconceptions.error: Gives the small form (ki-) for the big form (kijiti for jiti).

example.question: Mti mkubwa sana huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child mixes ji- (big) and ki- (small).
misconceptions.reveals: Both forms as options.
misconceptions.help: Big is ji-. Small is ki-.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukubwa wa nomino hutumia ji-: jiti, jito, jiji. Udogo hutumia ki-: kijiti, kijito, kijiji.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Keeps the noun as it is (mti mkubwa for jiti).

example.question: Mji mkubwa sana huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child uses the adjective mkubwa and does not change the noun.
misconceptions.reveals: The plain noun as an option.
misconceptions.help: Big form: the noun itself changes.
misconceptions.feedback: Kuonyesha ukubwa, nomino yenyewe hubadilika: mji-jiji.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one noun where there are many (jiti for majiti).

example.question: Miti mikubwa sana huitwa ___.

misconceptions.cause: The child does not change the form for many.
misconceptions.reveals: Singular and plural big forms in turn.
misconceptions.help: Count: one or many? Many takes ma-.
misconceptions.feedback: Wingi wa ukubwa hutumia ma-: majiti, majito, majiji, majitu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the big form but keeps the agreement of the ordinary noun (jitu anakuja for jitu linakuja).

example.question: Jaza: Jitu ___ kuja.

misconceptions.cause: The child changes the noun but not the verb.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Jitu ___ kuja." with "anakuja" among the options.
misconceptions.help: The big form moves to LI-YA: jitu li-, majitu ya-.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino ya ukubwa huchukua upatanisho wa LI-YA: jitu linakuja.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

rubrics.heading: Mwongozo wa viwango na vigezo vya kutathmini: Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kuwasiliana kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora (Matamshi ya sauti zinazokaribiana: p/b, t/d, k/g, ch/j)

levels.EE: Anawasiliana kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa kila wakati.
levels.ME: Anawasiliana kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa.
levels.AE: Anawasiliana kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora ya baadhi ya sauti lengwa.
levels.BE: Anawasiliana kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora ya baadhi ya sauti lengwa kwa kuelekezwa.

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kuzungumza na kujieleza kwa ufasaha (Kwa kutumia maneno ya upole na mazungumzo ya kimuktadha)

levels.EE: Anazungumza na kujieleza kwa ufasaha na kikamilifu akitumia maneno ya upole na katika miktadha
levels.ME: Anazungumza na kujieleza kwa ufasaha akitumia maneno ya upole na katika miktadha
levels.AE: Anazungumza na kujieleza kwa ufasaha akitumia baadhi ya maneno ya upole na katika miktadha
levels.BE: Anazungumza na kujieleza kwa ufasaha akitumia baadhi ya maneno ya upole na katika baadhi ya miktadha.

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kusikiliza na kujibu ipasavyo (Maamkuzi na maagano, ushairi, masimulizi)

levels.EE: Anasikiliza na kujibu maamkuzi na maagano, kusikiliza na kutoa masimulizi, na kukariri mashairi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe na ishara zifaazo kwa ubunifu.
levels.ME: Anasikiliza na kujibu maamkuzi na maagano, kusikiliza na kutoa masimulizi na kukariri mashairi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe na ishara zifaazo.
levels.AE: Anasikiliza na kujibu baadhi ya maamkuzi na maagano, kusikiliza na kutoa masimulizi, na kukariri mashairi kwa kiasi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe na ishara zifaazo.
levels.BE: Anasikiliza na kujibu baadhi ya maamkuzi na maagano, kusikiliza na kutoa baadhi ya masimulizi, na kukariri baadhi ya mashairi kwa kuzingatia ujumbe na ishara zifaazo kwa kuelekezwa.

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kutumia lugha kiubunifu (Vitendawili, methali nahau, visawe, tashbihi)

levels.EE: Anatumia lugha kiubunifu kwa kurejelea vitendawili, methali, nahau, visawe na tashbihi kwa utendeti.
levels.ME: Anatumia lugha kiubunifu kwa kurejelea vitendawili, methali, nahau, visawe na tashbihi.
levels.AE: Anatumia lugha kiubunifu kwa kurejelea baadhi ya vitendawili, methali, nahau, visawe na tashbihi.
levels.BE: Anatumia lugha kiubunifu kwa kurejelea baadhi ya vitendawili, methali, nahau, visawe na tashbihi kwa kusaidiwa.

rubrics.heading: Mwongozo wa viwango na vigezo vya kutathmini: Kusoma

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kusoma kwa ufahamu - Vifungu/ maigizo/ mashairi. (Ujumbe, umbo, wahusika matumizi ya msamiati mwafaka, kutoa muhtasari)

levels.EE: maigizo na mashairi na kutambua ujumbe, umbo, wahusika, na matumizi mwafaka ya msamiati kwa utendeti. Anatumia kamusi kwa
levels.ME: maigizo na mashairi na kutambua ujumbe, umbo, wahusika na matumizi mwafaka ya msamiati. Anatumia kamusi kwa
levels.AE: vifungu, maigizo na mashairi na kutambua ujumbe, umbo, wahusika na matumizi mwafaka ya msamiati. Anatumia kamusi kwa
levels.BE: vifungu, maigizo na mashairi na kutambua kwa kiasi ujumbe, umbo, wahusika na matumizi mwafaka ya msamiati. Anatumia kamusi kwa

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kusoma kwa kina. (Matumizi ya kamusi: mpangilio na maana za maneno)

levels.EE: kuzingatia mpangilio na maana za maneno kwa uketo. Anasoma kwa
levels.ME: kuzingatia mpangilio na maana za maneno. Anasoma kwa
levels.AE: kuzingatia mpangilio na maana za maneno kwa kiasi. Anasoma kwa
levels.BE: kuzingatia mpangilio na maana za maneno kwa kiasi akisaidiwa. Anasoma kwa kuzingatia

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kusoma kwa ufasaha. (Matamshi bora, kiwango kifaacho cha sauti, kasi ifaayo, ishara zifaazo)

levels.EE: kuzingatia vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha kikamilifu. Anasoma matini ya
levels.ME: kuzingatia vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha. Anasoma matini ya
levels.AE: kuzingatia baadhi ya vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha. Anasoma matini ya
levels.BE: baadhi ya vipengele vya kusoma kwa ufasaha kwa kuelekezwa. Anasoma matini ya

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kusoma kwa mapana. (Kutambua na kuchagua matini ya kusoma, kutambua ujumbe na matumizi ya lugha)

levels.EE: kujichagulia na kutambua ujumbe na matumizi ya lugha kwa mapana. Anasoma matini ya
levels.ME: kujichagulia na kutambua ujumbe na matumizi ya lugha. Anasoma matini ya
levels.AE: kujichagulia na kutambua kwa kiasi ujumbe na matumizi ya lugha. Anasoma matini ya
levels.BE: kujichagulia na kutambua kwa kiasi ujumbe na matumizi ya lugha kwa kusaidiwa. Anasoma matini ya

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kusoma kidijitali. (Kufungua faili ya kidijitali, matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali, kusakura matini kwenye tovuti salama, kuchagua na kusoma matini, kutambua ujumbe na matumizi ya lugha.)

levels.EE: kidijitali akizingatia vipengele vifaavyo kwa uketo.
levels.AE: kidijitali akizingatia baadhi ya vipengele vifaavyo.
levels.BE: kidijitali akizingatia baadhi ya vipengele vifaavyo akielekezwa.

rubrics.heading: Mwongozo wa viwango na vigezo vya kutathmini: Kuandika

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kuandika aina mbalimbali za insha (wasifu, masimulizi, maelezo na barua ya kirafiki) kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifuatavyo: muundo, ujumbe, mtindo na kanuni zifaazo za uandishi.

levels.EE: kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya uandishi kwa utendeti. Anaandika kwa
levels.ME: kwa kuzingatia vipengele vifaavyo vya uandishi. Anaandika kwa
levels.AE: kwa kuzingatia baadhi ya vipengele vifaavyo vya uandishi. Anaandika kwa
levels.BE: za insha kwa kuzingatia baadhi ya vipengele vifaavyo vya uandishi kwa kuongozwa. Anaandika kwa tarakilishi

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kuandika kwa tarakilishi. (Sehemu za tarakilishi, kufunga na kufungua tarakilishi, kuhifadhi).

levels.EE: tarakilishi kwa kuzingatia utaratibu ufaao kwa uketo.
levels.AE: tarakilishi kwa kuzingatia baadhi ya utaratibu ufaao.
levels.BE: kwa kuzingatia baadhi ya utaratibu ufaao kwa kusaidiwa.

rubrics.heading: Mwongozo wa viwango na vigezo vya kutathmini: Sarufi

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kutambua na kutumia aina maneno katika lugha ya Kiswahili. (Vitenzi, viwakilishi, vielezi, viunganishi, vihusishi na vihisishi)

levels.EE: Anatambua na kutumia aina katika matini kwa kina.
levels.ME: Anatambua na kutumia aina mbalimbali za maneno katika matini.
levels.AE: Anatambua na kutumia baadhi ya aina za maneno katika matini.
levels.BE: Anatambua na kutumia baadhi ya aina za maneno katika matini kwa kuongozwa.

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kutambua viambishi vya ngeli, nomino za ngeli na kutumia upatanisho wa kisarufi ipasavyo. (A-WA, U-I, KI-VI, LI-YA na LI -LI)

levels.EE: Anatambua viambishi vya ngeli, nomino za ngeli na kutumia upatanisho wa kisarufi ipasavyo na kwa wepesi.
levels.ME: Anatambua viambishi vya ngeli, nomino za ngeli na kutumia upatanisho wa kisarufi ipasavyo.
levels.AE: Anatambua baadhi ya viambishi vya ngeli, nomino za ngeli na kutumia upatanisho wa kisarufi ipasavyo.
levels.BE: Anatambua baadhi ya viambishi vya ngeli, nomino za ngeli na kutumia kwa kiasi upatanisho wa kisarufi ipasavyo.

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kutambua na kutumia vitenzi katika kauli (kauli ya kutenda, kutendea na kutendwa)

levels.EE: Anatambua na kutumia vitenzi katika kauli mbalimbali kwa uketo.
levels.ME: Anatambua na kutumia vitenzi katika kauli
levels.AE: Anatambua na kutumia vitenzi katika baadhi ya kauli.
levels.BE: Anatambua na kutumia vitenzi katika baadhi ya kauli kwa kuelekezwa.

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kutambua vinyume vya maneno na kuvitumia katika matini.

levels.EE: Anatambua vinyume vya maneno na kuvitumia katika matini kwa utendeti.
levels.ME: Anatambua vinyume vya maneno na kuvitumia katika matini.
levels.AE: Anatambua vinyume vya baadhi ya maneno na kuvitumia katika matini.
levels.BE: Anatambua vinyume vya baadhi ya maneno na kuvitumia katika matini kwa kusaidiwa.

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kutambua na kutumia viambishi vya nyakati katika vitenzi. (Wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao)

levels.EE: Anatambua na kutumia viambishi vya nyakati katika vitenzi kwa utendeti. Anatambua maneno
levels.ME: Anatambua na kutumia viambishi vya nyakati katika vitenzi. Anatambua maneno
levels.AE: Anatambua na kutumia baadhi ya viambishi vya nyakati katika vitenzi. Anatambua baadhi ya
levels.BE: Anatambua na kutumia baadhi ya viambishi vya nyakati katika vitenzi kwa kuongozwa. Anatambua baadhi ya

indicators.indicator: Kuweza kutambua maneno yaliyokanushwa, viambishi vya ukanushaji na kukanusha maneno ipasavyo. (Wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao)

levels.EE: yaliyokanushwa, viambishi vya ukanushaji na kukanusha maneno ipasavyo na kwa wepesi.
levels.ME: yaliyokanushwa, viambishi vya ukanushaji na kukanusha maneno ipasavyo.
levels.AE: maneno yaliyokanushwa, viambishi vya ukanushaji na kukanusha maneno ipasavyo.
levels.BE: maneno yaliyokanushwa, viambishi vya ukanushaji na kukanusha baadhi ya maneno.
